title: Copywriter
description:
About Atlas Media



Atlas Media is a growth marketing agency based in Singapore that creates high-performing campaigns that drive real business results. We specialise in performance marketing, content creation and lead generation across Meta, TikTok, Google and other platforms. To date, we have executed over 100 campaigns for established brands and growing businesses.



The Role



We’re looking for a Copywriter who writes to get results. You’ll write the scripts, hooks and ad copy behind our clients’ campaigns, for video, statics and carousels, and you’ll learn from the numbers what to write next.



You’ll work closely with our media buyers, editors and videographers, and with clients’ founders, to turn an offer and a customer problem into words that make people stop scrolling and take action. You’ll be judged on whether your work moves a number, such as hook rate, click-through rate or cost per lead, as well as on how well it reads.



Work Arrangement: Fully remote, open to candidates based in Malaysia

Working Hours: Mon to Fri, with core hours overlapping Singapore time (9am to 6pm SGT)



Key Responsibilities



Write direct response ad scripts and copy for Meta, TikTok and Google, including videos, statics and carousels.

Develop hooks and angles, drawing on each client’s customers, competitors and market.

Write organic content scripts, such as talking-head videos, UGC-style videos, trend-led formats and founder stories.

Write in each client’s voice, including helping founders say what only they can say.

Brief videographers, editors and on-camera talent so scripts are produced as intended.

Work with media buyers to read performance data (hook rate, click-through rate, cost per lead) and write the next round from what you learn.

Revise copy quickly against client feedback, within agreed rounds.

Build and maintain a library of hooks, angles and structures that have worked.



Qualifications



1 to 2 years’ experience in copywriting, content or direct response advertising, with agency or paid social experience preferred.

A portfolio of scripts or ad copy, ideally with results.

Understanding of direct response principles: hooks, pain points, objection handling and calls to action.

Understanding of short-form content on Instagram Reels and TikTok: hooks, pacing and retention.

Excellent written English, with an ear for how Singaporeans speak and read.

Comfortable using AI tools in your workflow, with your own judgement on the final output.

Able to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines independently, remotely.



Bonus Points



Experience writing for tuition, interior design, real estate or other local service businesses.

Experience writing scripts that people have filmed, and seeing how they performed.

Basic understanding of ad metrics and Meta Ads Manager.

Video editing or scripting-for-production experience.



About You



You read an offer and immediately ask who it’s for and what would make them stop scrolling.

You’d rather test two openings than argue about one.

You can write in a founder’s voice without making it sound like an ad.

You take feedback well and turn it round fast.

You’re organised enough to keep several accounts moving.



What to Expect



A small team where your work goes live fast.

Direct access to performance data, so you see how your copy performs.

Work across a mix of industries and formats.

A results-driven, collaborative culture with regular check-ins with the Singapore team.



To apply: Send your portfolio and 2 samples of ad scripts or copy. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short writing task.

title: HIRING: HIGH-VOLUME APPOINTMENT SETTER – LIFE INSURANCE
description:
# HIRING: HIGH-VOLUME APPOINTMENT SETTER – LIFE INSURANCE

**$5/Hour Base + Significant Performance Bonuses | Long-Term Growth Opportunity**



I am looking for an **EXTREMELY HUNGRY, AGGRESSIVE, AND HARDWORKING appointment setter** who knows how to pick up the phone, follow up relentlessly, qualify leads, and book appointments that actually SHOW UP.



**This is NOT a position for someone looking to make 100–200 dials per day and call it quits.** I need someone who understands that volume, consistency, and persistence are what drive results.



I am a life insurance agent specializing in Term Life, Whole Life, and Indexed Universal Life (IUL). I have active marketing campaigns generating fresh leads, along with an existing database of prospects who need consistent follow-up.



**YOU WILL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT RUNNING OUT OF LEADS.** I have the leads. I need someone willing to WORK them.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Make a very high volume of outbound calls daily, well beyond 100–200 dials when lead volume and calling conditions allow.

- Contact fresh leads from active marketing campaigns.

- Consistently follow up with older leads who haven't answered or committed.

- Qualify prospects by determining their interest in life insurance and willingness to speak with an agent.

- Schedule qualified appointments directly onto my calendar.

- Confirm appointments, send reminders, and follow up to maximize show-up rates.

- Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, appointments, and follow-ups.

- **Provide verifiable proof of daily dialing activity and results.**



### WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Someone who is **HUNGRY to make money and willing to outwork everyone else.**

- Extremely persistent, competitive, and results-driven.

- Comfortable making hundreds of calls daily and handling rejection.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.

- Excellent follow-up skills. One unanswered call does not mean the lead is dead.

- Reliable, organized, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

- Previous appointment-setting, cold-calling, or insurance experience is preferred but not required.



**You do NOT need to be a life insurance expert.** I can teach you the basics of Term Life, Whole Life, and IUL. Your job is not to sell the policy. Your job is to generate interest, qualify the prospect, schedule the appointment, and make sure they show up. I will handle the actual sales process.



### COMPENSATION & BONUSES

**Base Pay: $5 per hour**



I am willing to pay substantial performance bonuses to someone who consistently delivers results.



If I like the work you're doing and you're bringing me qualified appointments that actually show up, I will reward you accordingly.



**The right person could potentially DOUBLE their base earnings through bonuses.** Bonuses are performance-based, not guaranteed, and will depend on appointment quality, attendance, consistency, and overall results.



I am not looking for the cheapest employee. I am looking for someone who produces results and deserves to be paid well for them.



### MASSIVE LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This opportunity can become much bigger than working for just one agent.



I work in an office with **hundreds of insurance agents** who also need help with lead follow-up and appointment setting.



If you prove yourself, consistently perform, and demonstrate that you can deliver high-quality appointments, there may be opportunities to expand your workload, bring on additional setters, or potentially work with other agents in my network.



If you already have a team, friends who are appointment setters, or your own appointment-setting agency, this could turn into a much larger opportunity.



**But first, you need to prove yourself through your results.**



### IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is a high-volume outbound calling position. Many prospects will not answer the first time. Calls are generally short, meaning a motivated setter can make a substantial number of dialing attempts throughout the day.



I expect persistence, efficiency, accountability, and measurable performance. All calls and follow-ups must comply with applicable calling hours, opt-out requests, and telemarketing requirements.



**I don't need someone who just books appointments. I need someone who books appointments that SHOW UP.**



### HOW TO APPLY



Please send me:



1. Your previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

2. How many outbound dials you can realistically make in an 8-hour shift.

3. Your experience with CRMs, dialers, and appointment scheduling.

4. Your average appointments booked per day in previous roles, if applicable.

5. A short voice recording introducing yourself so I can evaluate your communication skills.



**If you're hungry, competitive, consistent, and want an opportunity where strong performance can lead to serious earning potential, I want to hear from you.**



**I PROVIDE THE LEADS. YOU PROVIDE THE WORK ETHIC. LET'S MAKE MONEY.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About Chuk Outdoors

Chuk Outdoors creates products to help people live comfortably outside for longer. Our flagship product, the Chuk Kitchen Box, is a portable, modular camp kitchen that sets up in seconds, keeps your gear organized, and collapses down for the drive home. Our mission is to help people get outside and choose the adventure. We sell to car campers and overlanders who care about quality gear, and we're a small, founder-led team from Vancouver, Canada.



Employer: Chuk Outdoors, Inc · Website: 
 · Contact: 



The Role

We're looking for a short-form video editor to turn our raw footage into scroll-stopping reels for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. We shoot and supply all footage and voiceovers. You make it sharp, fast, and on-brand. This begins with a paid trial, and we'll continue with one editor on an ongoing monthly basis.



What You'll Do

Edit 20 to 30 vertical videos per month (60 seconds or less each), with volume growing as we ramp.

Cut raw camping footage, POV cooking clips, and customer UGC into polished videos

Cut our long-form YouTube videos into short-form

Sync our voiceovers and add captions, on-screen text, sound design, and transitions

Use the Edits platform for music

Suggest hooks, formats, and trends that work in the camping and outdoor space

Share content ideas and storylines

Deliver on schedule, with one to two rounds of revisions

Potential to edit our long-form Youtube content as well

Content You'll Be Working On

Lifestyle and inspiration: campsite mornings, golden-hour cooking, ASMR, POV

Education: camp cooking hacks, setup tips, "mistakes to avoid"

Product in use: real-world demos, durability, UGC and testimonials

Community and behind-the-scenes: founder moments, customer spotlights



Who You Are

A strong portfolio of short-form edits, ideally outdoor, travel, automotive, or lifestyle

Skilled in CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar, and comfortable working in Edits

A natural feel for hooks, pacing, and retention in the first 3 seconds

A storyteller understanding the short-form story arc

Good with color, audio cleanup, and captions

Reliable and communicative, with 48 to 72 hour turnaround

A real interest in camping, overlanding, or outdoor cooking (a big plus)



Our Style

Genuine, plain-spoken, a little playful, and never salesy. Inspirational and aspirational, but also relatable. We avoid buzzwords and clichés, we only use high-quality HD footage, and we want videos that feel like a real trip, not an ad.



How We Work

Footage is shared through a Google Drive folder, and we'll provide a naming convention

We supply voiceovers where needed

Chuk owns all final content

You're an independent contractor: you set your own hours around agreed delivery dates and use your own equipment and software

Either side can end the agreement with 2 weeks' notice

Communication and accountability are paramount. Both sides completing what they say they will by the deadlines committed to (unless communicated otherwise prior to the deadlines).

You may show the finished work in your portfolio



Compensation (USD)

Paid trial: $150 for each shortlisted candidate, paid whether or not you're selected, to edit 2 to 3 reels from the footage pack we supply

For the first 1-4 months: about 7 to 12 reels per month, $500-600/month

From Spring on: ramp to 20 to 30 reels per month, 1000-1500/month

Paid monthly on the 1st of the month. Applying is free, and we never ask for unpaid or speculative work. Open to students, recent grads, and experienced editors, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds.



To Apply, Send Us

Your portfolio or 3 to 5 favorite short-form edits (outdoor or product work preferred)

The tools you use and your typical turnaround time

A paragraph or two on why you'd be a good fit for Chuk

title: YouTube Video Editor | Storytelling, Lifestyle & Cinematic Vlogs
description:
Creative YouTube Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)



I'm a lifestyle and home content creator looking for an exceptionally talented YouTube video editor to help bring my creative vision to life.



I'm not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together, adds transitions, and calls it a day. I'm looking for someone who genuinely **understands YouTube, loves storytelling, has incredible attention to detail, and knows how to make ordinary moments feel interesting and beautiful.**



This is an opportunity to grow alongside a creator and help build a YouTube channel from the ground up, with the potential for a long-term working relationship.



### The Creative Style



Please familiarize yourself with these YouTube creators before applying:



- Victoria Morse

- Alex Nicoll



I'm drawn to their thoughtful storytelling, beautiful visuals, natural pacing, personality, and ability to make everyday life engaging.



My content will focus on cozy minimalist living, home, lifestyle, routines, organization, creativity, and personal experiences.



The goal is to create videos that feel cinematic yet authentic, aesthetically beautiful without being overproduced, and personal without feeling forced.



### What I'm Looking For



**You MUST have previous experience editing long-form YouTube videos.**



Ideally, you're someone who:



- Understands storytelling, narrative structure, pacing, and audience retention.

- Knows how to create compelling openings that make viewers want to keep watching.

- Has an excellent eye for color grading, natural lighting, composition, and visual consistency.

- Can create smooth, intentional edits without relying on excessive transitions or effects.

- Understands music selection, sound design, ambient audio, and how sound contributes to emotion.

- Can identify the strongest moments in raw footage and build a cohesive story around them.

- Understands YouTube culture, current editing styles, and what makes videos successful.

- Can incorporate tasteful typography, subtle graphics, B-roll, and creative transitions when appropriate.

- Understands the difference between TikTok editing and long-form YouTube storytelling.

- Is comfortable editing lifestyle, home, vlog, and personality-driven content.

- Has a strong creative perspective and isn't afraid to suggest improvements.

- Has excellent attention to detail and can maintain consistency across videos.

- Is fluent in written and spoken English and can confidently understand conversational American English, humor, and cultural references.

- Is dependable, organized, communicative, and receptive to feedback.



**Most importantly, I want someone who goes the extra mile.**



Someone who notices when a scene could use better sound design, when an introduction isn't compelling enough, or when changing the sequence of clips could make the story significantly stronger.



I want a creative collaborator, not just someone following instructions.



### Your Responsibilities



- Edit engaging, polished long-form YouTube videos.

- Review raw footage and identify the strongest story.

- Develop compelling hooks, thoughtful pacing, and satisfying endings.

- Perform professional color correction and color grading.

- Source appropriate licensed or royalty-free music and sound effects.

- Incorporate tasteful B-roll, text, graphics, and transitions.

- Ensure consistent audio levels and polished sound.

- Make creative suggestions to improve storytelling and viewer retention.

- Deliver organized files and completed videos on schedule.

- Collaborate on revisions and continuously improve the editing style.



Bonus if you understand YouTube analytics, audience retention graphs, thumbnail strategy, and how editing decisions impact watch time.



### Software & Experience



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro is welcome.



I'm much more interested in your storytelling ability, editing taste, and past work than the specific software you use.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **Your portfolio:** Share 2 to 3 long-form YouTube videos you've personally edited. Clearly explain your role in each project.

2. **Your YouTube taste:** Who are your 3 favorite YouTube creators to watch, and what do you appreciate about their editing or storytelling?

3. **Your creative perspective:** Watch content from Victoria Morse, Alex Nicoll, or Alisson Baek. Tell me what you notice about their editing style and how you would approach creating something with a similar feeling while developing an original identity for my channel.

4. **Your storytelling process:** How do you turn raw footage without a script into an engaging YouTube video?

5. **Your experience:** How many years have you been editing YouTube videos, and which editing software do you use?

6. **Your availability and rate:** Please share your current availability, expected compensation, and typical turnaround time for a 25-30+ minute YouTube video.



Please begin your application with the words **"Sunday Storyteller"** so I know you've read the full description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test.



### The Opportunity



I'm looking for someone I can build a lasting creative partnership with.



As the channel grows, I'd love for this person to become increasingly involved in shaping its visual identity, storytelling approach, and overall creative direction.



If you genuinely love YouTube, have exceptional creative instincts, and take pride in making every video better than expected, I'd love to see your work.

# Business Consultant (Remote)



**About the Role**



We are looking for a motivated and analytical Business Consultant to support our international business development activities.



The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, business research capabilities, and an interest in working with international clients and markets.

- Support client relationship management and follow-up activities.

- Coordinate with internal team members on ongoing projects.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

- Good research, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to work independently and manage tasks remotely.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

- Previous experience in consulting, business development, sales, or market research is an advantage.



**What We Offer**



- Remote working opportunity.

- Flexible and professional working environment.

- Long-term cooperation opportunities.

- Opportunities to work on international business projects.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.



**How to Apply**



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction about your professional background.



In your application, please include:

1. Your relevant work experience.

2. Your English proficiency.

3. Why you are interested in this position.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Part-Time Accountant to Build Accounting System (Auto Repair Shop)
description:
I'm starting an auto repair shop in the US. I've tried setting up accounting myself — got payroll going, created a chart of accounts — but the system isn't working well. Transactions don't reconcile cleanly and categories are misaligned.



Looking for a creative, experienced accountant to rebuild our accounting system from scratch and keep it running clean. Not looking for someone rigid — need a problem-solver who understands accounting deeply but thinks flexibly.



What I Need:



Someone to audit what we have and explain why it's failing

Rebuild the system from the ground up according to our actual workflow

Reconcile everything back to launch (date a few months ago).

Set up a simple monthly routine that stays current

Prepare clean books for tax time

Important: I'm flexible on tools. I don't like QuickBooks, Xero, or any big platform if there's a simpler solution that fits. Open to open-source, custom spreadsheets, or lightweight tools.



Ideal Candidate:



Thinks creatively about accounting problems

Doesn't insist on "the only way"

Communicates plainly, not in jargon

Interested in a long-term partnership

Willing to document the system as you build it

Volume is low right now, but will grow with the business. This is about finding the right person to work with over months and years.

title: Creative AIGC Visual Desginer
description:
About Us

Premium Invention sells premium solar-powered security cameras direct to consumers in North America, the UK and Australia. We sell a high-ticket product that buyers research and compare before they commit — creative has to build trust fast, show the real product honestly, and answer the doubts that stop people from buying. We test constantly and judge creative on revenue, not impressions. You’ll sit next to the product team and the physical units in our Shenzhen office, with direct access to the CEO.



What You’ll Own

• Shoot real product photos and footage: lighting, angles, installed shots, unboxing, live app screens

• Edit photos and videos for Amazon listings, A+ pages, the company website, paid ads and
 campaigns

• Build lifestyle scenes using AI tools, then composite the real product in Photoshop at correct size, angle, lighting and detail

• Produce video ads (15–30s) for Meta, Google, Reels, Shorts and YouTube: cutting, colour grading, subtitles, sound, platform-specific exports

• Create Amazon listing images, A+ content, landing-page visuals and
 banners

• Own the product reference kit: every product photographed at true proportions, every angle, installed and in the box

• Keep the asset library organized in Google Drive so anyone can find the approved version

• Daily output with same-day revisions. You work from written English briefs and communicate progress, questions and blockers in English



This Role Is For You If

• Strong photo editing and retouching: compositing, masking, colour matching, perspective correction (Photoshop)

• Solid grasp of design fundamentals: typography, colour theory, composition and visual hierarchy. You know why a layout works, not just how to build one

• Video editing: cutting, colour, subtitles, sound, export per platform (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut or similar)

• Product photography: can light and shoot a small device cleanly on a tripod

• Working use of AI image and video tools (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI, Kling, Seedance, Runway or similar) — and a sharp eye for when AI output looks fake or gets product details wrong

• Can read a written brief and turn it into a finished visual that matches the brief's intent without inventing product features or faking details

• Comfortable working in English — written and spoken (MANDATORY). The briefs, feedback and the team all work in English

• A portfolio showing photo editing, compositing and video work. We need to see work made for Western consumers, or work that would clearly translate

• Figma for ad creative layouts, landing pages and quick iterations with the team



Strong Plus

• Experience producing visuals for Western DTC or Amazon markets

• Performance data on your creative (ROAS, CTR, conversion)

• Basic motion graphics

• Conversion-focused thinking: you design for thumb-stop, click-through and add-to-cart, not just aesthetics



Bonus If

• 3D rendering: Blender, KeyShot or similar

• Hardware or security product experience

• UGC-style video production



A Note on Pace

Daily output, same-day revisions, new briefs every week. During peak ecommerce seasons you'll juggle multiple campaigns at once under tight deadlines. The product line is expanding, so you'll be learning new hardware constantly and turning it into visuals that sell. It's a fit if you manage your own time well, handle pressure without dropping quality, and care about what the numbers say about your work.

If you build creative that sells, obsess over product accuracy, and can work from English briefs, we’d like to talk.

title: Creative Strategist | Meta Ads, DTC, E-commerce, DropShipping
description:
Creative Strategist | Meta Ads, DTC, E-commerce

Full-time | Remote | Philippines daytime hours

$1,800-$2,500/month depending on experience



ABOUT US

We’re an e-commerce team running our own online stores and regularly launching and testing products across different niches. Our work combines customer research, direct-response advertising, and AI-assisted creative production to find products and messages that resonate with buyers.



You’ll work directly with the founder and our existing team of video editors. We’re building a long-term team where people contribute ideas, see them brought to life, and learn from real advertising results.



Alongside our own stores, we’ve recently expanded into creative services for clients and brought on our first account. We’re looking for someone who wants to become a key part of the business, help shape our creative approach, and grow into broader responsibilities as we expand.



ROLE OVERVIEW

You’ll lead creative strategy for our own e-commerce stores and client accounts, d
 what we test and why. You’ll dig into customer reviews, competitor ads, product research, and Meta ad performance to uncover promising audiences, angles, and hooks. Then you’ll turn those insights into scripts and clear briefs for video and static ads, giving our AI video editors the direction they need to bring your ideas to life.



You’ll work with the founder and editors to take concepts through production, review, and testing, using performance results to shape the next round.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research products, competitors, customer pain points, desires, and objections.

- Develop audiences, angles, hooks, and messaging for our own products and client accounts, with clear reasoning behind what to test and why.

- Write direct-response scripts and briefs for video and static ads, including alternative hooks, headlines, and ad copy.

- Give our AI video editors clear visual direction, including key shots, scene flow, references, and what needs to be generated.

- Help structure creative tests and explain what each concept is intended to test.

- Work closely with the founder and editors to prioritize concepts, coordinate production, and provide actionable feedback on finished creatives.

- Analyze creative performance and use the findings to develop new concepts and variations.

- Keep briefs, creative status, and testing results organized, maintaining a steady flow of ideas through production and testing.

- Spot new formats and trends, and adapt them to each product.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Previous creative strategy and copywriting experience with e-commerce/dropshipping brands.

- Real-world ads you briefed or scripted, with results you can show or talk through.

- Strong understanding of direct-response advertising, and customer psychology.

- Familiarity with Meta ads, current online trends, and different advertising formats.

- Strong written English, storytelling, and communication skills.

- Ability to turn research into clear creative direction and work effectively with editors.

- Comfortable interpreting metrics such as CTR, CPA, and ROAS.

- Previous experience with AI creative is a plus.



WORK ETHIC & OWNERSHIP

This is especially important to us. We want someone who takes ownership, treats our stores and client accounts like their own, and cares about the actual results. That means:

- You bring a plan for what to test next without waiting to be asked.

- When an ad underperforms, you investigate why and propose what to improve.

- You keep fresh concepts moving into production before the team runs out of ideas.

- You meet deadlines and communicate early when something needs attention.

- You measure your contribution by business results, not just completed tasks.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A long-term, full-time, remote role with Philippines daytime working hours.

- $1,800-$2,500 per month with a clear path to salary increases as you deliver and as we grow.

- Opportunities to take on broader leadership responsibilities as our stores, client accounts, and creative team grow.

- Performance bonuses available.

- Direct collaboration with the founder and an existing team of video editors.

- See your ideas brought to life and tested quickly.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your subject line with “GROW WITH US” so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please number your answers and include:

1. Your resume.

2. At least three examples of creative briefs you developed, and the finished ads.

3. Performance results tied to those examples, including data like date range, ad spend, and ROAS or CPA (links, screenshots, or a short description of the numbers)

4. Your years of creative strategy experience in e-commerce/DTC.

5. The brands and products you’ve worked with.

6. Your current commitments and availability.

title: YouTube Video Editor — Real Estate Property Tours & Relocation Content (Long-Term)
description:
YouTube Video Editor — Real Estate Property Tours & Relocation Content (Long-Term)



Part-Time | Remote | 20–25 Hours/Week | $800–$1,100 USD/Month



I'm a full-time real estate agent building a YouTube channel called Living on the Alabama Gulf Coast, focused on helping people relocate to Baldwin County, Alabama.



I'm looking for an experienced, dependable YouTube video editor to join my team long-term.



This is NOT a short-form-only editing position. Experience editing engaging, long-form YouTube videos is essential.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Our channel produces two main types of content:



• Property and community tours: Typically 15–30 minutes, walking viewers through homes, neighborhoods, amenities, and nearby attractions.

• Talking-head and relocation videos: Typically 10–20 minutes, featuring local information, housing market insights, and advice for people moving to the area.



Our goal is to consistently publish two to three long-form YouTube videos per week, plus short-form clips repurposed from those videos.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit two polished long-form YouTube videos weekly

• Create clean cuts, natural pacing, subtle zooms, and engaging transitions

• Incorporate B-roll, maps, neighborhood footage, and relevant graphics

• Add tasteful text overlays highlighting home features and community information

• Clean and balance audio

• Create YouTube thumbnails 

• Repurpose videos into Shorts, Reels, and social clips

• Help prepare video titles, descriptions, and scheduled uploads

• Organize footage and completed projects in Google Drive

• Maintain consistent branding and meet agreed deadlines



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:

• Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos

• A portfolio featuring complete published YouTube videos, not just highlight reels

• Strong understanding of viewer retention and pacing

• Excellent English comprehension

• Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Descript, or equivalent software

• Dependable communication and turnaround times

• Ability to work independently after understanding our style



Preferred:

• Previous experience editing real estate, home tours, travel, lifestyle, or relocation videos

• Understanding of YouTube audience retention and storytelling

• Familiarity with Google Drive and Descript

title: Video Editor
description:
*NOW HIRING: Experienced Freelance YouTube Documentary Editor*



Hey guys!



I just finished a three-day shoot for the first episode of my new YouTube series, I Could Do That, and I'm looking for a highly experienced freelance video editor to help bring this project to life.



Our goal is to create professional, cinematic, long-form YouTube content similar to Michelle Khare's Challenge Accepted series.



We're looking for someone who understands storytelling, character development, humor, tension, emotional moments, and audience retention. This is much more than simply cutting clips together.



*JOB REQUIREMENTS*



1. *DaVinci Resolve:* Must be highly proficient in DaVinci Resolve, including editing, audio, color grading, and managing large projects.



2. *Professional Long-Form Experience:* Must have significant experience editing professional YouTube documentaries, challenges, adventure content, or similar videos, typically 15–30+ minutes long.



3. *Exceptional Storytelling:* Must understand how to turn hours of raw footage into an engaging story with a compelling hook, character development, challenges, setbacks, and a satisfying conclusion.



4. *Computer Capabilities:* Must own a powerful computer capable of editing professional 4K footage and managing approximately 750 GB of source media. For one shoot (3 Days)



5. *High-Speed Internet:* Must have reliable, high-speed internet capable of transferring large amounts of video footage.



6. *Fluent English:* Must speak and understand English fluently, at least at Abanadi's level, to communicate effectively during interviews, creative discussions, and revisions.



7. *Professional Portfolio:* Must provide at least two or three examples of long-form YouTube videos they personally edited.



*MANDATORY PREPARATION BEFORE YOUR INTERVIEW*



Before interviewing, you MUST spend time studying Michelle Khare's YouTube channel, particularly her Challenge Accepted series.



Come prepared to tell me your *three favorite videos* from her channel and explain:



- Why you selected each video.

- What makes the storytelling and editing effective.

- How you would apply those same techniques to our new series, I Could Do That.

- One editing decision you would have made differently and why.



*If you have not taken the time to watch and study Michelle Khare's channel, please do not schedule an interview.*



I'm looking for someone who genuinely understands the quality and storytelling we're trying to achieve.



*POSITION DETAILS*



- Freelance / project-based position

- Hourly compensation based on experience

- Flexible schedule with agreed-upon deadlines

- Potential for additional episodes and ongoing collaboration

- Paid editing test may be required before hiring

- No full-time commitment required



*HOW TO APPLY*



Please submit the following:



1. Full name and location

2. Two or three links to your best long-form videos that you personally edited

3. Your expected hourly rate in USD

4. Computer specifications, including RAM, GPU, processor, and available storage

5. Internet download and upload speeds

6. Your experience with DaVinci Resolve

7. A short introduction video in English explaining your professional editing experience



I'll personally interview the strongest candidates.



This is an opportunity to help build a new YouTube series from the ground up. I'm looking for someone who takes pride in their work, understands cinematic storytelling, and wants to create something exceptional.



Thanks!



Payton

title: Appointment Setter
description:
LUXURY DAY SPA  |  WELLINGTON, NEW ZEALAND

Reservations Agent

Digital Advertising, Bookings & Spa Operations  |  Remote – Philippines

Position Reservations Agent (full-time)

Business Luxury day spa based in Wellington, New Zealand (business name disclosed at interview stage)

Location Remote – based in the Philippines (work from home)

Reports to Managing Director (MD)

Hours 45 hours per week, aligned to the spa's trading days (Tuesday – Sunday) and including Saturdays

Shifts run approximately 7:00am – 3:00pm Philippine time (moving by one hour seasonally). Exact roster to be confirmed.

Base salary To be Discussed

Weekly bonus An additional amount , paid weekly, for every week that treatment revenue reaches $8,000 or more

Salary review After 6 months



About Us

We are a luxury day spa based in Wellington, New Zealand, offering a calm, contemporary escape with private treatment rooms, a steam room and a tranquil relaxation area. Our guests come to us to relax, rejuvenate and celebrate special occasions.

Our treatment menu includes luxury facials, relaxation and hot stone massages, body scrubs and wraps, hair therapy, foot rituals, pregnancy massage, and couples packages. We also offer midweek and seasonal specials, group bookings for birthdays and bridal showers, a membership program and gift vouchers.

About 95% of our clients are women, and they spend their time on TikTok, Instagram and
. Reaching them there, with beautiful and engaging content, is what fills our appointment book.

The Role

This is a hands-on, behind-the-scenes role that powers the whole business. You will create the advertising that makes the phone ring, turn those calls and
s into bookings in Zenoti, make sure our therapists deliver every treatment and are paid correctly, and then report on how the week performed so the next round of advertising is even better.

In short, you will be in charge of the full business cycle. It is a very interesting and rewarding role for a dedicated person who likes to see the direct result of their work, and when weekly treatment revenue reaches $8,000 or more, you share in that success with a weekly bonus.

The business cycle you will own



Why advertising comes first

Advertising is the engine of this role. Excellent, eye-catching content is what generates the calls and
s that become bookings. If the advertising is not done well, the calls and
s stop, and everything else in the cycle slows down. We are looking for someone who takes real ownership of this.

Key Responsibilities

1. Innovative AI advertising and content (the most important part of the role)

▪Zenoti marketing: run client campaigns and promotions through Zenoti's built-in marketing tools as the primary channel to our existing client base.

▪Paid social and search: plan, launch and manage ads across Meta 
 and Instagram, via Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager), TikTok, Google Ads and LinkedIn, within the budget agreed with the MD.

▪AI-powered creative: create innovative ads using AI tools for video, images, animation and copy, and connect AI video and animation platforms such as Higgsfield to produce scroll-stopping content.

▪Video library: build and keep a steady supply of attractive short-form videos (TikToks, Reels, Stories) showcasing our treatments, spa facilities, couples packages and current specials.

▪Know the audience: design every campaign for our core audience of women, with a strong focus on TikTok, Instagram and
.

▪Promote what sells: push midweek and seasonal specials, group and celebration bookings, gift vouchers and our membership program.

▪Measure and improve: track reach, enquiries, cost per booking and revenue from each campaign, and use those results to improve the next round of content.

2. Customer enquiries – phone and

▪Answer customer phone calls and
s promptly, warmly and professionally, in excellent English.

▪Advise customers on treatments, packages, pricing, availability, gift vouchers and spa policies, including the cancellation and rescheduling policy.

▪Turn enquiries into confirmed bookings and follow up on enquiries that have not yet booked.

3. Appointment setting in Zenoti

▪Create, reschedule and cancel appointments in Zenoti, matching each booking to available therapists and treatment rooms.

▪Fill the appointment book efficiently to make the most of therapist time and our treatment rooms.

▪Keep client records, notes and contact details accurate and up to date.

4. Staff coordination and treatment completion

▪Maintain close, daily communication with therapists and spa staff on WhatsApp about bookings, changes and customer queries.

▪Make sure every booked appointment goes ahead as planned and resolve any issues quickly.

▪Once a treatment is finished, confirm that payment has been taken and the appointment is correctly closed off in Zenoti.

5. Staff timesheet approval

▪Approve staff timesheets in line with the Sign-In and Sign-Off Procedure document, so staff are paid correctly and on time.

▪Identify and flag any missing sign-ins, sign-offs or discrepancies to the MD before approval.

6. Recruitment and training coordination

▪Advertise open positions for spa staff on job boards and manage incoming applications.

▪Schedule and coordinate training sessions with therapists.

7. Reporting and business performance

▪Run sales and treatment revenue reports in Zenoti and track weekly revenue against the $8,000 target.

▪Update the cash-up reporting every Saturday.

▪Update the weekly PowerPoint report and present it to the MD.

▪Share insights on what is working, and feed them back into the next advertising campaigns.

How Success Is Measured

▪Weekly treatment revenue, with a target of $8,000 or more

▪Number of calls and
s generated by advertising

▪Enquiry-to-booking conversion rate and speed of response to customers

▪Consistent, high-quality content and ads posted to an agreed schedule

▪Payment confirmed for every completed treatment

▪Accurate timesheets, cash-up reports and on-time Saturday reporting to the MD

About You

Must have

▪Excellent English speaking and writing skills. This is essential: you will be the voice of a luxury day spa on the phone and in writing.

▪Proven experience creating social media content and running paid ads on Meta, TikTok and/or Google Ads.

▪Hands-on experience with AI tools for video, image and copy creation, and a genuine passion for creative, innovative content.

▪Customer service experience by phone and
, ideally with New Zealand or other international customers.

▪Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage many tasks at once.

▪Confident with Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint, and comfortable presenting results.

▪A professional work-from-home setup, including:

–A stable, high-speed internet connection

–A calm, quiet working environment with no background noise

–A good-quality PC or laptop

–A good-quality headset with a clear microphone, so your voice is clear on every call

–An uninterrupted power supply (UPS) and a power backup for outages

Nice to have

▪Experience with Zenoti or another spa or salon booking system (such as Fresha, Mindbody or Timely).

▪Background in a spa, beauty, wellness or hospitality business.

▪Video editing skills (for example CapCut or Canva) and LinkedIn advertising experience.

▪Experience with recruitment advertising or staff scheduling.

Personal qualities

▪Dedicated, self-motivated and takes ownership of results

▪Creative, curious and quick to try new AI tools and ideas

▪Warm, professional and calm with customers and staff

▪Commercially minded: you care about bookings and revenue, not just likes

Why You Will Love This Role

▪You run the full business cycle, from the first ad to the final report, and see the direct impact of your work every week.

▪Creative freedom to experiment with the latest AI advertising and video tools.

▪A weekly bonus that rewards you when the spa does well.

▪Work closely with the MD of a luxury day spa in New Zealand.

How to Apply

Please apply through this job listing and include:

▪Your CV

▪A short cover letter in English explaining why you are right for this role

▪Links to ads, videos or social media content you have created (AI-generated work especially welcome)

▪A 1 – 2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself in English

▪Message  Whatsapp  (
)   your name : Reservations Agent

Regulated Resilience is a video podcast hosted by Katrina Maniec, PA-C, MBA. It’s about the science of stress, breath, and human performance. Each episode is a 30–45 minute interview with a medical specialist about what chronic stress does to the body and how to recover. The audience is mostly healthcare professionals and high performers, so the edit should feel clean, credible, and professional, not flashy.



What you’ll do



Edit full-length two-person video interviews in Descript or Riverside, using the separate host and guest tracks.

Add the host’s pre-recorded cold open at the start of each episode, before the show’s opener.

Add the show’s existing opener and sign-off clips to each episode.

Add an episode title card at the start of each episode.

Add on-screen name titles for each speaker, with their name and credentials (e.g., “Dr. Jamie Knight, Psychologist & Founder, Olfactory Health”).

Remove dead air, false starts, filler, and tangents, without cutting the meaning of the medical content.

Keep audio and video in sync and fix levels so both voices sound even.

Switch layouts based on who’s talking: show only the active speaker full-screen during longer answers, and go to side-by-side for back-and-forth conversation. Cuts should feel smooth, not jumpy.

Replace or improve the host’s background as needed (e.g., adding artwork behind her), so it looks natural and not like an obvious green screen or blur. Clean edges around hair and shoulders are a must.

Add captions in our brand style.

Export final videos and upload them to our Google Drive folder.

Nice to have: cut 3–5 short vertical clips per episode for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.



Must have



Strong experience editing podcast or interview video in Descript and Riverside, including Riverside’s editor, Magic Clips, and captions (required).

Also comfortable in another editor (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut).

Experience with natural-looking background replacement.

Excellent English comprehension. You’ll be cutting medical conversations, so you need to understand what’s being said.

Can handle large files (2–5 GB) through Google Drive.

Knows how to handle each platform’s file limits. For example, compressing large exports to fit Riverside’s 500 MB upload limit without hurting quality.

Reliable turnaround: 48–72 hours per episode.

Good communication. We’re in New York (Eastern Time), and overnight turnaround is fine.



Important



No music. The show uses no theme or background music.

Some content is unreleased guest interviews, so you’ll need to keep files confidential.



Paid test task

Shortlisted applicants will edit a short section (about 10 minutes) of a real episode, paid at your quoted rate, including speaker name titles, layout switching, and captions. We’ll hire based on the test.



To apply

Send:



Links to 2–3 podcast or interview videos you edited (YouTube or Drive links).

An example of a background replacement you’ve done.

Your rate (hourly or per episode).

How long you’ve used Descript and Riverside, and which you prefer for interview edits.

Start your message with the words “Regulated Resilience” so we know you read the full post.

title: VA FOR AMAZON
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant to help with Amazon product sourcing, wholesale research, and supplier discovery.



The ideal candidate will help identify profitable products to sell on Amazon, research potential brands and distributors, review wholesale catalogs, and build a database of suppliers and purchasing opportunities.



We are looking for someone who can independently research opportunities, think critically, and consistently bring forward new products and suppliers for our business.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Amazon Product Research & Sourcing**

- Research potential wholesale products to sell on Amazon.

- Identify products with strong sales potential, demand, and healthy profit margins.

- Analyze Amazon listings, competition, sales estimates, pricing, and number of sellers.

- Use tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, Helium 10, or similar product research software.

- Identify products with manageable competition and opportunities for wholesale resale.

- Analyze product variations, sales history, Buy Box pricing, and seller competition.



**2. Wholesale Catalog Research**

- Review wholesale catalogs, price lists, and supplier spreadsheets.

- Identify products that are already selling well on Amazon.

- Compare wholesale costs against current Amazon selling prices.

- Calculate estimated Amazon fees, profit margins, ROI, and potential profitability.

- Organize promising products into spreadsheets for review.



**3. Brand & Distributor Research**

- Find brands offering wholesale accounts or authorized distributor programs.

- Identify distributors, importers, and wholesalers that supply products suitable for Amazon resale.

- Research brands with limited competition or opportunities in the Canadian and US Amazon marketplaces.

- Find supplier contact information, including purchasing managers, sales representatives, and wholesale departments.

- Identify potential brands and distributors we can contact to establish wholesale relationships.



**4. Supplier Outreach & Lead Generation**

- Compile lists of potential brands, wholesalers, and distributors.

- Prepare professional outreach
s using provided templates.

- Follow up with suppliers when required.

- Track responses, wholesale account applications, catalogs, and pricing information.

- Maintain an organized database of supplier contacts and opportunities.



### Requirements

- Previous experience with Amazon FBA wholesale or online arbitrage research is preferred.

- Knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon product research.

- Experience using Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, or similar tools.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Ability to research brands, manufacturers, importers, and distributors.

- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

- Good written English and professional communication.

- Ability to work independently and meet weekly targets.



### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience sourcing products for Amazon Canada and Amazon USA.

- Experience reviewing wholesale catalogs and supplier price lists.

- Understanding of Amazon FBA fees, ROI, profit margins, and sales estimates.

- Experience finding authorized wholesalers and establishing supplier relationships.



### Expected Deliverables



We expect consistent weekly results, including:



- A list of researched Amazon wholesale product opportunities.

- An organized spreadsheet of profitable products identified from supplier catalogs.

- A list of new brands, distributors, and wholesalers to contact.

- Supplier contact information and outreach tracking.

- Product profitability analysis, including estimated fees, ROI, and margins.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Describe your previous experience with Amazon wholesale sourcing.

2. What product research tools have you used?

3. Have you worked with wholesale catalogs or distributor price lists before?

4. Provide an example of a product you have sourced or researched for Amazon.

5. Explain how you evaluate whether a product is worth selling on Amazon.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship as our sourcing operations grow.

title: FP&A Reporting
description:
SCOPE OF SERVICES

Purpose

Lake City Plating LLC is requesting quotes from qualified independent contractors to provide remote FP&A, financial reporting, and data analysis services on a part-time basis. This is a solicitation for professional services, not a job posting or offer of employment.



Requested Services and Deliverables

• Prepare month-end financial reporting and variance analysis, including budget, forecast, prior-year, and period-over-period comparisons with concise explanations of material drivers.

• Analyze inventory, purchasing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash flow, and working capital trends; identify risks, exceptions, and operational or financial impacts.

• Build and improve financial statement dashboards, support schedules, and repeatable reporting processes using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Excel, Power Query, and Power BI.

• Generate recurring and ad hoc financial reports and perform special projects involving profitability, margins, costs, cash flow, forecasting, data cleanup, process improvement, or management decision support.

• Reconcile reports and dashboards to the general ledger and financial statements; document data sources, account mappings, assumptions, calculations, refresh steps, exceptions, and review controls.

• Provide clear conclusions, key drivers, unresolved issues, and recommended next actions, along with editable workpapers, dashboards, models, queries, and process documentation.

Systems, Security, and Work Standards

• Work will be performed remotely using secure, company-approved access and collaboration methods.

• Company data may not be stored in personal cloud storage, shared with unauthorized parties, or entered into unapproved artificial intelligence or external processing tools.

• Deliverables must be accurate, maintainable by company personnel, supported by clear audit trails, and free of undocumented manual steps or black-box calculations.

• The contractor must follow company confidentiality, data-security, document-retention, and access-control requirements and promptly report suspected unauthorized access or data loss.

Contractor Qualifications

• Demonstrated FP&A, accounting, financial reporting, or data analysis experience, preferably in manufacturing, inventory, purchasing, or multi-site operations.

• Strong knowledge of financial statements, month-end reporting, variance analysis, working capital, inventory, purchasing, and management reporting.

• Advanced Excel and Power Query skills; experience with Power BI and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is preferred.

• Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial results clearly and professionally to management.

• Ability to work independently, identify incomplete or inconsistent data, meet agreed deadlines, and maintain confidential financial information.



Quote Requirements

• Contractor name, contact information, location, and summary of relevant experience.

• Proposed pricing, including hourly rate, retainer or project fees, minimum billing increments, expenses, invoice frequency, and payment terms.

• Estimated monthly capacity, availability during month-end close, anticipated response time, and proposed approach to reporting, quality review, documentation, and data security.

• Assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, required access or software, proposed subcontractor use, and potential conflicts of interest.

• Two professional references or representative project examples and the period for which the quote remains valid.

Independent Contractor and Commercial Terms

• The engagement will be governed by a written independent contractor agreement, confidentiality and security requirements, and approved statements of work or written project authorizations.

• The contractor will control the manner and means of performing the services, subject to agreed deliverables, deadlines, quality standards, security requirements, and authorized system access.

• The contractor is responsible for applicable taxes, insurance, licenses, tools, and business expenses and is not eligible for employee wages, overtime, benefits, paid time off, or other employee programs.

• Use of subcontractors requires prior written approval. Company-specific deliverables, data, models, documentation, and other work product will be handled as stated in the final agreement.

• This RFQ does not obligate Lake City Plating LLC to award work, reimburse proposal costs, or accept any quote. Scope, pricing, timing, ownership, and final terms remain subject to written agreement.

Evaluation and Submission

Quotes will be evaluated based on relevant experience, technical capability, communication, security practices, availability, proposed approach, and overall value. Submit the quote and supporting information to the company contact identified in the RFQ communication. Work may begin only after the applicable agreement is signed and written authorization is provided.

Company Notice

Lake City Plating LLC reserves the right to accept or reject any quote, request clarification, negotiate scope or pricing, discontinue the RFQ process, or engage more than one service provider. Information provided during the RFQ process must be treated as confidential and used only to prepare the quote.

This is NOT cold calling. Every lead has already filled out a form asking us for a quote. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust, and close.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Call new leads within minutes of their form submission, qualify them, give the quote, and book their first clean

Handle price objections and close over the phone

Follow up by call, text, and
 with leads who don’t book right away

Reactivate old leads that went cold

Convert first-time clients into recurring weekly, biweekly, or monthly service

Answer client calls and texts: questions, rescheduling, and touch-up requests

Keep every lead and client updated in Go High Level and Booking Koala (notes, pipeline stage, next step)

You will not manage cleaner schedules. The owner handles that, and you book into the openings we give you.

Excellent spoken English: clear, warm, and confident with American customers

Go High Level experience (strongly preferred) or Booking Koala or another CRM

Able to work US Pacific hours (night shift in the Philippines)

Fast, stable internet with a backup connection and backup power

Quiet workspace and a noise-canceling headset

Looking for a long-term role, not a side gig



SCHEDULE

[Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time] = [12:00 AM–9:00 AM Philippine Time]



PAY



$5-6 an hour

Monthly bonus based on your close rate (details shared in the interview)

Long-term role with raises based on performance

title: Client Intake & Outreach Specialist - Mortgage Sales
description:
Client Intake & Outreach Specialist



Mortgage Brain AI | Remote, Philippines | Full-Time



Schedule: Full-time, flexible hours with required overlap during Canadian Eastern Time business hours



Compensation: $500–$800/month, depending on experience, plus performance-based bonuses



About Mortgage Brain AI



Mortgage Brain AI is a Canadian company helping Ontario homeowners explore mortgage and home-equity options, including refinancing and debt consolidation.



We combine technology with personalized support to help clients better understand their options and take the next step with confidence.



We're looking for a reliable, organized, and confident communicator to join our growing team. If you enjoy speaking with people, staying organized, and following through on tasks, this could be a great long-term opportunity.



About the Role



As our Client Intake & Outreach Specialist, you'll be responsible for connecting with prospective clients who have already expressed interest in our services.



Your job is to make that first connection, ask straightforward questions, gather basic information, and help qualified inquiries move to the next stage of our intake process.



You'll work closely with our Canadian client relations team to ensure they receive accurate information and can focus their time on clients who are ready for a more detailed conversation.



We provide the leads, training, scripts, and systems. You won't need to find your own clients or sell mortgage products.**



This is a client-facing role, so strong communication, attention to detail, and consistent follow-up are essential.



What You'll Do



Client Outreach & Initial Screening



- Contact warm inbound leads and existing inquiries through phone,
, and SMS.

- Respond promptly and professionally to prospective clients.

- Follow structured scripts to ask basic qualifying questions and gather important client information.

- Confirm details such as homeownership, location, reason for inquiry, and other information required by our intake process.

- Identify whether a client is interested and ready to speak with our Canadian client relations team.

- Schedule appointments and coordinate smooth handoffs to the appropriate team member.

- Follow up with clients who have not responded or have not completed the initial intake process.



CRM & Administrative Support



- Maintain accurate client information, notes, and follow-up activities in our CRM.

- Update lead statuses, appointments, and assigned tasks.

- Keep records of client communications and outstanding information.

- Manage daily outreach lists and ensure no assigned inquiries are overlooked.

- Work closely with our Canadian team to communicate client updates and follow-up requirements.

- Track outreach activity and progress using our existing systems and procedures.



What We're Looking For



- At least 1 year of experience in virtual assistance, customer service, client outreach, appointment setting, or sales support.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, professional telephone communication.

- Confidence making outbound calls and speaking with prospective clients.

- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask questions naturally.

- Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

- Experience using CRM platforms and maintaining accurate client records.

- Comfortable working with
, calendars, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools.

- Ability to follow established scripts and processes while maintaining natural, personable conversations.

- A proactive, dependable attitude and willingness to learn.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a suitable computer setup.

- Availability to work a consistent full-time schedule with some overlap during Canadian business hours.



*Nice to Have*



- Previous experience supporting Canadian or North American businesses.

- Experience in mortgage, real estate, financial services, or another client-focused industry.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

- Experience managing warm leads, booking appointments, or conducting initial client screening.



**Mortgage industry experience is not required but preferred.** We provide training on our services, intake questions, systems, and processes.



What We Offer



- Competitive monthly compensation based on experience, plus performance-based bonuses.

- Long-term, full-time remote opportunity.

- Flexible scheduling with agreed Canadian business-hour overlap.

- Paid training and ongoing support.

- Clear processes, scripts, and performance expectations.

- An established CRM and steady flow of incoming leads.

- Opportunities to develop your communication, client service, and administrative skills.

- A supportive team that values reliability, accountability, and results.



What Success Looks Like



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their daily responsibilities and consistently follows through.



Success in this role means:



- New leads are contacted promptly.

- Prospective clients receive professional and friendly communication.

- Basic intake information is collected accurately.

- Suitable, interested clients are booked for the next stage of the process.

- Follow-up tasks and CRM records are consistently maintained.

- Our Canadian client relations team receives clear, organized handoffs.

- Clients have a positive experience from their very first interaction.



This position focuses on initial outreach, information gathering, and appointment coordination. Mortgage advice, qualification assessments, and product recommendations are handled by appropriately licensed professionals.

Ready to Apply?



If you're confident on the phone, organized, dependable, and looking for a long-term opportunity with a Canadian company, we'd love to hear from you.



To apply, please:



1. Send your résumé and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

title: Senior Funnel Builder (Funnelish) — Urgent Hiring
description:
SENIOR FUNNEL BUILDER (FUNNELISH) — URGENT HIRING



Remote | Part-Time | Immediate Start | Long-Term Opportunity



PAY: $20 USD per completed funnel (fixed price)



OUTPUT TARGET: 2 Complete Funnels Per Day



URGENT PROJECT: 5 Funnels Needed This Week



ABOUT US



We are SPUVARA, a growing European e-commerce and dropshipping business operating primarily in the Netherlands and Belgium.



We are urgently looking for an experienced Funnelish Builder who can independently build complete, high-converting sales funnels.



We have already selected 5 products through Product Research and have their competitor reference funnels ready.



Our goal is to have all 5 funnels completed by the end of this week.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We need someone who knows Funnelish inside out, works fast, understands conversion psychology, and takes full ownership of every project.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITY — EXACT FUNNEL REPLICATION



Your main responsibility is to recreate the competitor/reference funnels we provide with extremely high visual, structural, and functional accuracy, using authorized materials.



Every funnel is different. Depending on the reference, it may include:



- Advertorial → Landing Page → Checkout

- Advertorial → Checkout

- Landing Page → Checkout

- Other page combinations depending on the competitor



You must reproduce ALL relevant pages and the complete buying journey of each reference funnel.



This includes:



- Page structure, sections, and layouts

- Headlines, copy, and storytelling

- Product images and demonstrations

- Fonts, colors, backgrounds, and spacing

- CTA buttons and positioning

- Product offers and quantity selectors

- Approved testimonials, trust elements, and FAQs

- Checkout design and functionality

- Accurate desktop and mobile versions



Do not replace the original funnel with generic templates or unnecessarily remove important sections.



MANDATORY THANK YOU PAGE



EVERY completed funnel MUST include a functional Thank You Page, even if the competitor does not have one.



The Thank You Page must appear after a successful purchase, thank the customer, confirm the order, and explain what happens next.



A funnel is NOT considered complete without a working Thank You Page.



Upsells, downsells, and order bumps must also be included when required by the reference or our instructions.



TECHNICAL SETUP — REQUIRED



After building each funnel, you must complete the following technical tasks:



1. FUNNELISH CHECKOUT



- Configure the checkout and connect the correct products.

- Set up the required Purchase automation in Funnelish.

- Ensure the checkout and purchase flow work correctly.

- Verify the connection to the Thank You Page.



2. SHOPIFY



- Create the products required for each funnel.

- Add the provided product information, images, variants, and prices.

- Connect the correct Shopify products to their respective Funnelish checkouts.

- Verify that products, quantities, and prices are correctly configured.



We will provide the necessary Shopify access with restricted permissions.



3. WETRACKED INTEGRATION



We will provide access to our WeTracked account.



Your responsibilities are to:



- Add and configure each new funnel inside WeTracked.

- Follow the integration instructions provided by WeTracked.

- Create and configure the WeTracked automation inside Funnelish.

- Add the required WeTracked Custom Code in the Funnelish funnel settings.

- Verify that the integration is correctly installed and functioning.



These are the only external integration tasks required.



CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION — FULL AUTONOMY



We want someone who understands WHY funnels convert, not just how to build pages.



You are encouraged to independently identify and implement practical improvements, such as:



- Better CTA visibility and placement

- Improved mobile responsiveness

- Faster page loading

- Better readability and visual hierarchy

- Clearer product offer presentation

- Reduced checkout friction

- Fixing broken links, buttons, images, and technical issues



You do NOT need approval for routine design, technical, UX, or conversion improvements.



We want someone who takes initiative and solves problems without constant supervision.



However, preserve the essential structure of the competitor reference. Do not independently change product prices, guarantees, factual product claims, or payment settings.



Briefly summarize meaningful improvements when delivering each funnel.



REQUIREMENTS



MANDATORY:



- Proven hands-on Funnelish experience

- Experience building e-commerce and dropshipping funnels

- Ability to accurately replicate competitor reference funnels

- Understanding of direct-response marketing and conversion psychology

- Experience with Funnelish checkout configuration and automations

- Shopify product creation and Funnelish connection experience

- Ability to configure WeTracked integrations

- Good HTML/CSS knowledge

- Excellent mobile-responsive design skills

- Fluent English communication

- Strong attention to detail

- Immediate availability and ability to work independently



HIGHLY PREFERRED:



- 2+ years of Funnelish experience

- 20+ complete funnels built

- Experience with Meta Ads funnels

- Experience with Dutch or multilingual funnels

- Strong Conversion Rate Optimization knowledge



MINDSET NON-NEGOTIABLES



- You take full ownership — no chasing, no reminders.

- You care about conversion.

- You understand funnels are systems, not pages.

- You move fast without breaking structure.

- You catch your own mistakes before anyone else does.

- You get better every week, not just complete tasks.

- You thrive in a high-output testing environment and take honest feedback well.



PAYMENT & OPPORTUNITY



Payment: $20 USD per completed and approved funnel.



Part-time, project-based collaboration.



We have 5 funnels ready to build immediately, with more projects planned.



We provide competitor reference links, product information, copy, creative assets, and the necessary platform access.



Each delivery must include:



- Complete Funnelish funnel matching the reference

- Functional checkout and Purchase automation

- Mandatory Thank You Page

- Shopify products created and connected

- WeTracked funnel integration, Funnelish automation, and Custom Code

- Final functionality and mobile QA



The exact deliverables and payment terms will be agreed before starting.



Long-term collaboration is available for the right candidate.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Portfolio review

2. Short interview

3. Initial paid trial funnel

4. Assignment of the remaining funnels if successful



HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



1. At least 3 examples of funnels you personally built using Funnelish.

2. Your years of Funnelish experience and approximate number of funnels built.

3. Your experience with Shopify, Funnelish Purchase automations, and WeTracked integrations.

4. Confirmation that you can start immediately.

5. Confirmation that you can realistically deliver 2 complete funnels per day.

6. Your availability and timezone.

7. Confirmation that you accept $20 USD per fully completed funnel, including the technical setup listed above.



Applications without real Funnelish portfolio examples will not be prioritized.



WE ARE REVIEWING APPLICATIONS IMMEDIATELY AND ARE READY TO HIRE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

title: AU Social Media Manager | Short-Form Video Editing & Content Publishing
description:
Full Time | Fully Remote | $1500/month | AU hours



To apply, please send:

c. Answer to the questions below



Only applicants who provide accurate and complete information would be entertained.



We're looking for a hands-on Social Media Manager to manage the day-to-day content publishing and social media operations. 



This role is heavily focused on content execution, social media scheduling, and short-form video editing. You'll be responsible for keeping our social channels active, organized, and consistently updated across multiple platforms.



A major part of this position involves editing short-form videos, including Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and repurposed content from longer recordings and podcast episodes.



We're looking for someone who is comfortable working behind the scenes, managing content calendars, preparing posts, editing videos, and making sure everything gets published on schedule.



Important: This is an in-house position. You'll be managing the company's own social media accounts, not handling social media accounts for external clients.



What You'll Be Doing



1. Social Media Management & Publishing

- Manage day-to-day social media publishing across Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

- Maintain and update weekly content calendars to ensure consistent posting.

- Schedule and publish approved content using tools such as Meta Business Suite, Later, or Metricool.

- Write captions, hooks, and accompanying copy that align with the company's brand voice.

- Ensure content is properly formatted and optimized for each platform.



2. Short-Form Video Editing

- Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other social platforms.

- Turn raw footage and longer recordings into engaging, platform-ready video content.

- Repurpose podcast episodes and other long-form content into shorter clips.

- Add subtitles, captions, music, transitions, cuts, and simple text animations.

- Ensure videos are properly formatted and ready for publishing.



3. Community Management

- Monitor and manage comments, direct messages, and audience interactions.

- Respond to routine inquiries and engage with the online community.

- Keep track of audience interactions and flag anything requiring attention.



4. Reporting & Organization

- Maintain organized content calendars and publishing schedules.

- Prepare simple monthly social media reports covering reach, engagement, and audience growth.

- Ensure content deadlines and publishing schedules are consistently met.



What We're Looking For

- At least 2 years of experience managing social media accounts for brands or an agency.**

- Previous experience as a Social Media Manager or Social Media Specialist. Experienced Content or Community Coordinators are also welcome, provided they have personally handled content scheduling, publishing, and editing.

- Strong hands-on experience editing short-form videos for social media.

- Proficiency in CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Experience using social media scheduling tools such as Meta Business Suite, Later, or Metricool.

- Experience maintaining content calendars and managing multiple social media platforms.

- Good writing skills, particularly when creating social media captions and hooks.

- Experience with community management and monthly social media reporting.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing recurring publishing deadlines independently.



Nice to Have

- Experience working with podcast content and repurposing long-form recordings into short-form videos.

- Canva proficiency.

- Familiarity with AI-powered creative and content production tools.

- Previous experience working in a digital marketing environment.



Application Requirements

IMPORTANT: A short-form video editing portfolio is REQUIRED. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



When applying, it's required include:

a. Your updated resume.

b. A portfolio or samples of short-form videos you've personally edited, preferably Reels, TikTok videos, or podcast clips.

c. Answer to the questions below



Only applicants who provide accurate and complete information would be entertained.



1. Walk us through how you build and maintain a weekly content calendar. What tools do you use (Meta Business Suite, Later, Metricool, others), and how do you keep several accounts on schedule?

2. Tell us about a time you took a long-form piece, like a podcast episode, and turned it into short clips. How did you choose the moments, and what did you add (captions, music, text animation)?

3. How do you adapt hooks and captions across platforms and brand voices? Give us a specific example of the same idea written two different ways.

4.Tell us about a post or account that wasn’t performing well. Which metrics did you look at, what did you change, and what happened afterward?

5. How do you handle comments and direct messages, including negative or sensitive ones? Give us an example.



Please make sure your portfolio demonstrates your actual video editing work, not just static graphics or social media content designs.



We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong editing skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage consistent social media publishing.
