title: B2B & Ecommerce Order Fulfillment Specialist
description:
OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

B2B Sales & Fulfillment, Customer Experience, Listings & Systems

Full-time | Remote (overlaps US business hours) | Reports to Lisa Hu, Founder & CEO





ABOUT LUX & NYX



Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel served by promotional-products distributors. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.





THE ROLE



You'll own our corporate gifting business from the first
 to the day the order lands. Nearly every inquiry comes from a promotional-products distributor who is pitching Lux & Nyx to their client. You answer them the same day, send quotes they can trust, and follow every open quote until it becomes a yes or a no. When it becomes a yes, you plan the order backward from the date it has to arrive: artwork, decoration, kitting, cartons, labels, and shipping, with every party lined up in time. You'll also look after our direct-to-consumer customers, keep our marketplace listings and systems current, and take on new system updates as the business grows.



This role is half conversation and half precision. You need to be warm and confident with a buyer, and you need to refuse to send anything when a number doesn't add up. The most valuable thing you do is tell a distributor exactly what it takes to hit their date, before anyone promises it.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Inquiries & quotes: answer distributor and corporate inquiries the same business day. Quote price, minimums, colorways, decoration options, and lead times accurately, and check stock and the timeline before you commit to any date.



2. Quote follow-up: keep every open quote in our pipeline tracker with a next step and the client's event date. Quotes often stay open for months, so you check in with each distributor on a steady cadence and time your follow-ups to their client's deadline, so nothing goes quiet without a decision.



3. Order entry & confirmation: when a quote becomes an order, re-check stock, pricing, and timing before you confirm. Log every PO clean, and make sure the PO, the quote, and the confirmation all match before anything goes out.



4. Backward planning: for every dated order, build the timeline back from the in-hand date: when art must be approved, when the designer and decorator must start, when the warehouse kits and ships. Then make sure each person gets what they need on time.



5. Pack-out & shipping: work out cartons and shipping labels from our pack-out spec (a partial carton is still a carton), confirm counts with the warehouse before labels are made, and run a final check before anything ships. If a number isn't on file, you go get it. You never estimate it.



6. DTC customer experience: answer customer
s and messages from our own site and social within 24 hours, warmly and in our brand voice: order questions, product questions, and warranty and return requests, handled by our policies and followed through to resolution.



7. Marketplace & catalog listings: manage our product listings on Amazon, Nordstrom, and our Mirakl-based retailer marketplaces, plus B2B supplier catalogs (such as ESP, SAGE, and distributor and rewards platforms). That means day-to-day product data entry and updates (images, pricing, specs) whenever a product, price, or color changes, checked against our master sheet and followed through until each listing is live and correct. Larger batch uploads are handled with a marketplace specialist.



8. Systems, updates & SOPs: keep one source of truth for quotes, orders, and product data, take on other system and data updates across our platforms as they come up, and write down every step so the process never lives in one person's head.



9. AI & tooling (evolving): use AI to speed up drafting and repetitive steps where it helps, and help shape what's worth automating.



Not part of this role: Amazon and retail-marketplace customer service (another teammate owns that), and cold outbound prospecting (our founder and sales consultant own that).





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



1. You stop rather than send. If a price, date, or count doesn't reconcile, nothing goes out until it does. That's the #1 thing.

2. You plan backward from the deadline. Give you an in-hand date and you can tell us the date every step has to start, and who needs to hear about it first.

3. 3+ years in B2B order management: promotional products, corporate gifting, wholesale, or similar, with orders that run for weeks across several outside parties (vendors, decorators, warehouses, carriers).

4. Clear, polished English, written and spoken. You can hold a buyer conversation on your own, quote with confidence, and say "here's what it takes" instead of an easy yes. With our direct customers, you're warm, quick, and on-brand.

5. Organized follow-through on a pipeline: dozens of open quotes at once, each with a next step, none forgotten.

6. A builder. When something was never written down, you write it down, get it checked, and make it the standard.

7. Comfortable with product data entry and uploads from spreadsheet templates, with zero tolerance for a wrong price or spec going live. We'll train you on our marketplace SOPs. Amazon Seller Central, retailer-portal (Nordstrom, Mirakl), or supplier-catalog (ESP, SAGE) experience is a plus.

8. Comfortable with the tools: Shopify, spreadsheets with formulas, a CRM or pipeline tracker, and AI for drafting.

9. Calm and steady in async, remote, founder-led work, with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

10. Here for the long haul: someone who wants to own this work and get great at it, not use it as a stepping stone.





WHAT SEPARATES GREAT FROM GOOD



1. Tells a distributor "here's what it takes to hit your date" instead of just yes or no.

2. Notices the number that's missing, and goes and gets it instead of guessing.

3. Briefs the designer at the start of the order, not the end.

4. Follows up because a deadline is coming, not just because time has passed.

5. Documents as they go, so nothing lives in one person's head.

6. Steady when gifting season hits.





HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Targets calibrate quarterly. These are the outcomes you'll actually be measured on:



- Inquiry response: same business day

- DTC customer response: every inquiry answered in under 24h; nothing dropped

- Quote accuracy: zero quotes sent with a wrong price, minimum, or lead time

- Quote follow-through: every open quote tracked with a next step; none goes quiet without a decision

- On-time delivery: every B2B order arrives by its in-hand date

- Order & shipment accuracy: zero incomplete shipments; cartons = labels = packing list

- Listing accuracy: zero live errors (price / spec / image) on Amazon, retailer portals, and B2B catalogs

- Pre-send checks: zero documents released with a number that doesn't reconcile

- SOP coverage: every recurring step documented





HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



1. Weekly 1:1 with Lisa (founder & CEO): priorities, open quotes, what's shipping, and what's at risk.

2. Day-to-day coordination with Michelle (operations) and our warehouse team on fulfillment.

3. Quarterly planning: themes, major moments (holiday, gifting season), and KPI targets.

4. Async-first via Slack: decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.





COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Competitive compensation tied to experience and location. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word CLEAN, and in three sentences tell us about an order with a hard deadline that you planned backward from: what had to happen when, and who you had to line up. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won't be read.



That one line is deliberate: it's how we see, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and whether you own the details instead of waiting for someone to catch them for you.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



We keep it simple and respect your time:

1. Apply: the word CLEAN, three sentences, and your resume.

2. If shortlisted: a short recorded answer (3–5 minutes) to a few questions we send you.

3. If invited: a paid skills test based on real work ($30, about 4 hours, paid regardless of outcome).

4. Final steps: an interview with our founder and reference check.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant and aim to make a decision within 3 weeks.





ABOUT THE TEAM



We're a remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, regular 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting. We lead before we're asked. We think from the customer's perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that's how you work too, we'd love to meet you.

title: US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper
description:
Job Title: US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper

Location: Remote

Engagement Type: Task-Based | Gig Work | Project-Based

Starting Rate: $6.00/hour equivalent or agreed project-based rate



Overview

We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional with hands-on experience in US tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial reporting.

This is a task-based gig opportunity for an independent professional who can complete specific tax preparation, bookkeeping, and accounting assignments based on business requirements. Rather than following a traditional full-time work schedule, the engagement will focus on assigned tasks, clearly defined deliverables, accuracy, and agreed completion deadlines. The selected professional will support our accounting and tax operations by preparing individual, business, nonprofit, and state tax returns, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring that clients' books remain organized, compliant, and tax-ready.



This opportunity is ideal for someone who can work independently, manage multiple assignments, maintain high-quality standards, and consistently deliver accurate work within agreed timelines.



Job Details

As a US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper, you will manage tax preparation and bookkeeping responsibilities for multiple clients, maintain organized documentation, and support efficient accounting workflows. Your work will play a key role in ensuring compliance, financial accuracy, and a seamless tax preparation process for our clients.

You will initially undergo a partial onboarding and testing phase designed to evaluate your technical skills, accuracy, quality of work, efficiency, and ability to meet established performance expectations.

The testing phase may include practical assignments involving actual tax and bookkeeping scenarios. The workload will be based on assigned tasks and business needs and will not necessarily require a full five-day workload.



What You'll Be Doing

Tax Preparation & Compliance

Prepare Individual Tax Returns (Form 1040) and related schedules.

Prepare Business Tax Returns, including Forms 1120, 1120S, and 1065.

Prepare Sole Proprietorship, Partnership, LLC, S Corporation, and C Corporation tax returns.

Prepare and file nonprofit tax returns, including IRS Form 990-EZ and the full IRS Form 990, while ensuring compliance with nonprofit tax regulations.

Prepare and file state and franchise tax returns in accordance with applicable state requirements.

Review financial records to ensure accuracy, completeness, and tax readiness.

Identify missing information and communicate with clients or internal team members as needed.

Maintain organized digital tax workpapers and supporting documentation.

Assist with complex, amended, and specialized tax returns as assigned.

Support year-round tax, bookkeeping, and payroll-related client needs.

Bookkeeping & Financial Management

Perform bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online.

Categorize financial transactions accurately.

Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements.

Clean up and correct incomplete or inaccurate bookkeeping records when necessary.

Prepare monthly financial reports, including Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

Maintain accurate accounting records and ensure clients' books remain tax-ready throughout the year.



Data Entry & Administrative Support

Perform accurate data entry and document management.

Upload and organize client files using consistent naming conventions and folder structures.

Track assignments and meet internal deadlines.

Assist with administrative support related to accounting and tax operations.

Maintain confidentiality and proper handling of client financial information.



Systems & Process Improvement

Follow established workflows, SOPs, and internal checklists.

Create or update process documentation when needed.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen internal processes, and reduce errors.

Adapt to new accounting, tax, and productivity tools as required.

Work collaboratively with the team while maintaining the ability to work independently.



What You Bring to the Role

Proven experience preparing US Individual Income Tax Returns (Form 1040) and Business Tax Returns, including Sole Proprietorships, Partnerships, LLCs, S Corporations, and C Corporations.

Experience preparing and filing nonprofit tax returns, including IRS Form 990. Experience with both Form 990-EZ and the full Form 990 is highly preferred, along with the ability to independently prepare nonprofit filings.

Experience preparing and filing state and franchise tax returns, with an understanding of franchise tax compliance requirements in one or more US states.

Strong bookkeeping experience, including monthly bookkeeping, account reconciliations, financial record maintenance, bookkeeping cleanups, and preparation of financial statements.

Experience managing bookkeeping and tax preparation for multiple clients or businesses simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.



Proficiency with QuickBooks Online.

Experience using professional US tax software such as TaxSlayer, Drake, ProSeries, UltraTax, Lacerte, TaxAct Professional, or similar platforms.

Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.

Excellent time management with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines.

Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the team.

A commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work and maintaining client confidentiality.

Willingness to learn, adapt, and contribute to a growing, process-driven organization.



Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working with a US accounting, bookkeeping, CPA, or tax preparation firm.

Experience preparing multiple nonprofit tax returns annually.

Experience handling franchise tax filings for multiple states.

Strong understanding of GAAP-based bookkeeping principles.

Experience developing or improving accounting workflows and documentation.

Experience supporting payroll and year-round accounting services.

Experience working with complex or amended tax returns.



What You Can Expect

Starting Rate: $6.00/hour equivalent or an agreed project-based rate, depending on the assignment.

Performance Review: Evaluation after 90 days of collaboration, where applicable.

Compensation Growth: Opportunity for a rate increase based on technical competency, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and overall contribution.

Flexible Engagement: No fixed daily working hours or mandatory five-day workweek.

Task-Based Compensation: Payment based on agreed assignments, completed deliverables, or approved project milestones.

Recurring Opportunities: Possibility of receiving regular or recurring tax preparation and bookkeeping assignments.

Professional Exposure: Opportunities to work on individual, business, nonprofit, and multi-state tax matters.

Independent Work Environment: Flexibility to manage your working schedule while meeting agreed deadlines and quality standards.

Performance-Based Growth: Opportunities to handle more complex assignments and higher-value projects as your capabilities develop.

Long-Term Collaboration: Potential for continued engagement as client volume and business requirements expand.



Initial Testing & Evaluation

Our selection process prioritizes demonstrated technical ability and actual work output.

The process includes:

Application review.

Initial interview or technical assessment, if necessary.

Paid production-based testing involving actual tax preparation and bookkeeping scenarios.

Evaluation based on:

Technical knowledge and competency.

Accuracy and completeness of work.

Quality of tax returns and bookkeeping deliverables.

Attention to detail.

Efficiency and adherence to agreed deadlines.

Ability to follow instructions and established procedures.

Communication and responsiveness.

Ability to work independently.

Approval for potential ongoing assignments.

Testing assignments will be selected based on the candidate's experience and current business requirements. The candidate will not necessarily be required to complete a full five-day workload during this phase. Once assigned tasks are completed, the candidate may conclude their work for the day.

System access may initially be provided on a limited basis during the testing and evaluation process.

Successful completion of the paid testing phase may lead to additional assignments and longer-term collaboration.



About the Company

We are a growing accounting and tax services company focused on providing accurate, reliable, and efficient support to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations. Our goal is to build a strong remote team that values integrity, accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement.

We believe in building long-term relationships with both our clients and our team members while creating opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you have proven US tax preparation and bookkeeping experience and are looking for a long-term remote opportunity where you can grow your skills, contribute to a growing team, and take on greater responsibilities based on performance, we encourage you to apply.

We’re looking for a proactive and highly organised Events Coordinator with hands-on event experience to support STRIVE Conferences, with additional event-related support across The Accommodation Show and iBooked.online.



Our brands work within the accommodation and short-term rental industry, bringing together owners, operators, innovators and industry leaders.



This role focuses on the coordination and follow-through that make events run smoothly. You’ll help keep people informed, information accurate and preparations on track, from early planning through to post-event follow-up.



What You’ll Be Doing



Event Planning & Coordination

Supporting the planning and delivery of conferences and other business events

Maintaining event timelines, checklists, schedules and run sheets

Tracking deadlines, outstanding requirements and follow-up actions

Coordinating venue information, supplier requirements and event logistics

Keeping event programmes and planning documents accurate and up to date

Flagging potential issues early and helping find practical solutions

Supporting the team with last-minute changes as events approach



Speaker, Sponsor & Exhibitor Coordination

Acting as a reliable point of contact for speakers, sponsors, exhibitors and partners

Following up for bios, headshots, logos, presentation files and other required information

Communicating deadlines, schedules and event instructions clearly

Tracking sponsor and exhibitor inclusions to help ensure commitments are delivered

Coordinating presentation requirements and sharing relevant details with the team

Maintaining accurate contact records and communication trackers



Attendee Communications & Registration Support

Responding to attendee enquiries professionally and promptly

Supporting ticketing, registration and attendee communications

Helping prepare event reminders, joining instructions and essential event information

Keeping attendee lists and registration records organised

Supporting ticket campaigns across Pre-Release, Early Bird, General Release and Last-Minute stages

Helping prepare registration lists, name badges and check-in materials when required



Event Materials & Promotional Support

Coordinating the preparation of signage, presentation screens, programmes and other event materials

Checking names, dates, logos, links and event details before materials are published or printed

Working with the design and marketing team on speaker announcements, sponsor promotions and event updates

Making simple updates in Canva when required

Organising event photos, videos and presentation files

Supporting post-event surveys, thank-you communications and follow-up activities



Organisation & Administration

Keeping Asana tasks, spreadsheets and event trackers updated

Organising Google Drive folders and event documents

Maintaining contact and CRM records

Researching venues, suppliers, speakers and potential event partners

Creating and improving event checklists and simple SOPs

Following up consistently so outstanding tasks reach completion



What We’re Looking For

Previous experience organising or supporting events is essential. This could include conferences, exhibitions, corporate events, workshops or similar professional events.

You should be able to explain the events you’ve worked on, what you were responsible for and how you helped deliver them.



You’ll be a strong fit if you:

Understand the preparation and coordination involved before, during and after an event

Can manage several deadlines and keep track of many moving pieces

Communicate confidently with speakers, sponsors, suppliers and attendees

Are comfortable following up politely and persistently

Have a strong eye for detail, especially names, dates, schedules and commitments

Write clear, friendly and professional English

Stay calm when plans change and respond with practical solutions

Take ownership of tasks and follow them through without constant supervision

Ask questions when information is missing or instructions are unclear

Are reliable, responsive and comfortable working remotely

Experience with Google Workspace, Asana, spreadsheets, CRM systems, ticketing platforms and Canva would be an advantage.

Experience in accommodation, hospitality or short-term rentals would be helpful, but is not essential.

Speakers know what they need to submit and when. Sponsors receive clear communication and their agreed inclusions are tracked. Attendees receive accurate information. Event documents are current, and the team can see what is ready, what is outstanding and what needs attention.

We’re looking for someone who understands how events work and enjoys taking ownership of the details that bring them together.

The role will initially be approximately 20 hours per week, with the possibility of increasing over time depending on performance, availability and business needs.

We’ll agree on regular working hours, with some overlap with the Australian business day. During conference periods, priorities and hours may occasionally shift as events approach.



Why Join Us?

You’ll help deliver events that connect people across the accommodation and short-term rental industry.

You’ll work closely with our team, build relationships with speakers and partners, contribute ideas and improve the systems behind our events. As you grow into the role, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility.



How to Apply

Your availability and preferred hourly rate

We're looking for a proactive, creative and highly organised Social Media & Events Coordinator to support three growing brands in the accommodation and short-term rental industry:



STRIVE Conferences

The Accommodation Show

iBooked.online



This is a varied role combining social media management, content creation, event coordination and day-to-day communication.



One day you might be scheduling a week of social content, the next you're creating speaker graphics, following up with a sponsor, updating an event schedule or making sure everything is ready for an upcoming conference.



What You'll Be Doing

-Creating and scheduling social media posts across multiple brands

-Writing captions for posts, videos, podcasts, speakers, sponsors and events

Events & Conference Support

-Communicating with speakers, sponsors, exhibitors, partners and suppliers

-Following up for speaker bios, headshots, logos and presentation information

-Preparing speaker and sponsor announcement content

-Helping manage event schedules, run sheets and programme updates

-Creating and updating event graphics, signage, presentation screens and promotional materials

-Helping manage attendee communications and event enquiries

-Supporting ticket campaigns including Pre-Release, Early Bird, General Release and Last-Minute promotions

-Keeping speaker, sponsor and attendee information organised

-Helping coordinate event suppliers and venue information

-Assisting with post-event content, videos, photos and social media



Organisation & Administration

-Keeping Asana tasks updated and following up on deadlines

-Maintaining spreadsheets, trackers and content calendars

-Organising Google Drive folders, images, videos and event documents

-Keeping contact and CRM information organised

-Researching speakers, suppliers, venues, partners and content ideas

-Writing simple SOPs and checklists for recurring tasks

-Spotting missing information, incorrect dates or inconsistencies before they become a problem

-Helping improve systems and processes as you learn the role



You'll Love This Role If You

-Enjoy social media and understand what makes content engaging

-Are confident using Canva

-Can write clear, friendly and professional English

-Have a very strong eye for detail

-Notice incorrect dates, spelling, links and information

-Can manage several projects and deadlines at the same time

-Enjoy organising events and coordinating with different people

-Are comfortable following up with speakers, sponsors and suppliers

-Can take instructions and turn them into finished work without needing constant supervision

-Are proactive and comfortable asking questions when something doesn't make sense

-Respond quickly and don't leave messages sitting unanswered

-Enjoy learning new tools and systems

-Can work independently in a remote environment

-Are reliable, organised and easy to communicate with

-Experience with Canva, Meta Business Suite, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, ContentStudio, Google Workspace, Asana, CRM systems or event coordination would be a big advantage.

-Experience in accommodation, hospitality, short-term rentals, conferences or events would also be helpful, but isn't essential.



What We're Looking

-We're not looking for someone who only wants to post on social media.

-We need someone who can take ownership of the details behind the content and events.

-You should be comfortable moving between creative work and organised administrative work. You might create a speaker graphic in the morning, update an event programme after lunch and follow up with sponsors before finishing for the day.

-Being organised and dependable is just as important as being creative.





The role will initially be approximately 20 hours per week, with the possibility of increasing over time depending on performance, availability and business needs.

Why Join Us?

description:

Alien Prints is a growing custom apparel company based in Addison, Illinois, serving businesses with screen printing, embroidery, and DTF apparel. We're looking for a confident, organized sales professional who enjoys speaking with customers and turning incoming inquiries into paid orders.



You'll work with customers who have already contacted us, so there's no cold prospecting. You'll receive support from our design team and training on our products and ordering process. Strong sales professionals from other industries are encouraged to apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

s, and follow up with interested customers.

title: Google Ads Specialist – Real Estate Investor / Motivated Seller Lead Generation
description:
About Us



We are a growing real estate investment company focused on purchasing residential properties directly from homeowners for cash, as-is. Our goal is to help homeowners sell their properties quickly without repairs, agent commissions, or the traditional listing process.



We're looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist who can generate high-quality motivated seller leads through strategic Google advertising campaigns.



Role Overview



We are seeking a highly skilled Google Ads Specialist with proven experience running successful PPC campaigns for real estate investors, cash home buyers, or similar businesses.

Your primary responsibility will be to create, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns that attract homeowners actively searching to sell their houses quickly for cash.

We are not looking for someone who simply generates clicks or website traffic. We need someone who understands how to generate qualified seller leads at a profitable cost.



Key Responsibilities

Google Ads Campaign Management:

Build, launch, and manage Google Search Ads campaigns targeting motivated homeowners.

Conduct keyword research for high-intent searches such as "sell my house fast," "cash home buyers," and "we buy houses."

Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, geographic targeting, and negative keywords.

Evaluate Search Ads versus Performance Max campaigns and determine the most effective strategy.

Continuously optimize campaigns to improve conversions and lower cost per lead.

Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization:

Generate qualified homeowner leads through phone calls and website submissions.

Optimize landing pages to increase conversion rates.

Implement and manage conversion tracking through Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.

Track lead quality and identify which campaigns produce actual seller opportunities.

Conduct A/B testing on advertisements, landing pages, and messaging.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting:

Monitor cost per click (CPC), cost per lead (CPL), conversion rates, and overall campaign performance.

Provide weekly reports outlining campaign results, spending, and opportunities for improvement.

Work closely with our acquisitions team to evaluate lead quality and closed deals.

Develop strategies to scale successful campaigns while maintaining profitability.



Qualifications



Proven experience managing successful Google Ads campaigns.



Previous experience generating motivated seller leads for real estate investors, cash home buyers, or "We Buy Houses" companies is strongly preferred.



Strong understanding of Google Search Ads, Performance Max, and conversion-based bidding strategies.



Experience managing competitive PPC campaigns in local markets.



Proficiency with Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.



Experience optimizing landing pages for lead generation.



Strong understanding of keyword research, negative keywords, and search intent.



Ability to analyze campaign performance and make data-driven decisions.



Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.



Preferred Experience



Experience advertising for real estate wholesalers, house-flipping companies, or cash home buyers.



Familiarity with motivated seller audiences, including inherited properties, distressed homes, and homeowners needing to sell quickly.



Experience with WordPress landing pages.



Experience with call tracking software and CRM integrations.



Experience scaling Google Ads campaigns while maintaining a profitable cost per qualified lead.



Compensation & Schedule



Full Time & Part-time position with a flexible schedule.



Competitive hourly rate based on experience.

Performance-based bonuses tied to qualified lead generation and campaign profitability.

Opportunity for long-term growth as our advertising budget increases.



Application Requirements



Please submit:



Your resume and relevant Google Ads experience.

Examples or case studies of Google Ads campaigns you have successfully managed.

Your experience generating motivated seller leads for real estate investors or cash home buyers.

Examples of previous campaign budgets, cost per lead, and conversion rates.

A brief explanation of how you would approach generating motivated seller leads through Google Ads.



IMPORTANT: Please DO NOT apply if you are new to Google Ads or have never successfully managed lead-generation campaigns.



We strongly prefer candidates who have direct experience generating motivated seller leads for real estate investment companies.



We are looking for someone who can deliver measurable results, not someone who needs to learn the industry from scratch.

title: Remote UGC Marketing Agency Recruiter (Flexible Schedule)
description:
We are a growing US-based digital marketing agency helping brands reach new audiences through organic TikTok marketing campaigns.



We are expanding our creator network in the Philippines and looking for reliable, motivated individuals to help us connect with people interested in creating TikTok slideshow content.



Our agency provides creators with the content materials, instructions, and guidance they need to get started. Creators do not need prior experience, an established TikTok account, or a large following to participate.



This is a flexible, remote opportunity for someone who is comfortable communicating online, finding potential creators, and helping interested individuals get started.



What You’ll Be Doing:



- Find and connect with people in the Philippines who are interested in earning money through TikTok slideshow content.

- Look for potential creators through
 groups, Reddit, 
 communities, TikTok, university networks, and other online platforms.

- Reach out to potential creators using provided templates while keeping conversations natural and professional.

- Answer basic questions and guide interested people through the application and onboarding process.

- Keep track of outreach activity, including people contacted and application forms sent.

- Provide daily updates on your progress, results, and any challenges.

- Stay in communication with the team and ask questions when you need help.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- Comfortable communicating in written English.

- Confident starting conversations and reaching out to people online.

- Organized, dependable, and self-motivated.

- Able to follow instructions and work toward daily and monthly targets.

- Comfortable with outreach, follow-ups, and performance-based compensation.

- Consistent with daily check-ins and progress reports.

- Able to respond to messages and communicate reliably.



Having experience in recruitment, sales, lead generation, social media, virtual assistance, or customer support is a plus, but it is not required.



You must also have a valid PayPal account to receive payments.



Important: No Creator Experience Required:



You are not expected to recruit established influencers or people with large social media followings.



The creators we are looking for can be complete beginners. They do not need an existing audience, an established TikTok account, or previous content creation experience.



Your role is to find people who are interested and willing to participate. Our team provides the content materials, instructions, and guidance to help them get started.



Flexible Schedule & Daily Communication:



This position does not have fixed working hours or required shifts. You can organize your work around school, another job, or your personal schedule.



However, flexibility does not mean the role is inactive or occasional. You are expected to complete outreach consistently, provide daily check-ins, track your activity, and remain responsive to the team.



Missing regular updates, failing to report progress, or repeatedly becoming unresponsive may result in removal from the position.



Compensation:



This is a performance-based side-income opportunity, not a traditional hourly or full-time position.



You can earn through a combination of a monthly base payment and completed creator onboardings.



Base Payment:

- $30 per 30-day cycle if you successfully onboard at least 35 creators during that cycle.

- If you onboard fewer than 35 creators, you will not qualify for the base payment, but you will still receive the applicable performance earnings.



Performance-Based Pay:



Payment increases as you onboard more creators:



- Creators 1–50: $1 per creator.

- Creators 51–100: $2 per creator.

- Creators 101 and above: $3 per creator.



Each rate applies only to the creators within that tier. Higher rates do not apply to creators from previous tiers.



Example Earnings:

- 35 completed onboardings: $65 total ($30 base + $35 performance pay).

- 50 completed onboardings: $80 total ($30 base + $50 performance pay).

- 75 completed onboardings: $130 total ($30 base + $100 performance pay).

- 100 completed onboardings: $180 total ($30 base + $150 performance pay).



The goal is to consistently work toward approximately 50 or more completed creator onboardings per cycle.



Each cycle runs for 30 days, and payments are sent through PayPal at the end of the cycle. Continued participation and base payment eligibility depend on meeting performance expectations and maintaining consistent communication and reporting.



 Opportunity for Growth:



Recruiters who consistently deliver strong results, communicate reliably, and demonstrate leadership may have opportunities to advance into roles such as Recruitment Manager or Client Manager.



How to Apply:



If you are interested, please answer the following questions:



1. Where would you look to find people in the Philippines who might be interested in earning money by posting TikTok slideshow content? Provide at least three specific groups, communities, or platforms you would use.

2. Tell us why you would be a good fit for this position. Include any relevant experience and explain how you would organize your leads, manage daily outreach, track your results, and communicate with the team.



We are looking for people who are serious about the opportunity, willing to learn, and able to stay consistent. If you are dependable, organized, and comfortable reaching out to people online, we encourage you to apply.

description:
Financial Statement Analyst (Full-Time, Remote) — US Bookkeeping Firm



Job type: Full-time, 40 hrs/week

Schedule: TBD depending on what your needs are. 

Start date: Two Weeks



About the role



I am a US CPA and university accounting professor who is starting a cutting edge bookkeeping company. I’m looking for one sharp, detail-driven analyst whose main job is to catch what others miss. You will review monthly financial statements and review the books, find the errors, and explain them clearly before anything goes to a client.

Review monthly balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements for up to 30 small-business clients

Write short, plain-English review notes explaining each issue found and the recommended correction

Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy or Accounting. CPA license is a plus but not required — a strong eye for errors matters more than a title.

2+ years’ experience in audit, financial statement review, month-end close, or just heading up an accounting department for another company

Solid command of US GAAP basics: accruals, depreciation, revenue recognition, debt vs. equity

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (lookups, pivot tables, conditional formatting)

Excellent written English. You will be explaining errors to a US CPA in writing every day.

Naturally skeptical. You don’t accept a number because the software produced it.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, own computer



What you’ll get



Long-term, stable full-time position directly with the owner, not an agency

Paid Philippine holidays and paid time off after a probationary period

Direct mentorship from a renowned CPA and PhD ; real skills growth toward senior review and controller-level work



How to apply



To show me you read this far, please start your application with the word RECONCILE on the first line. Then include:



A short paragraph (5–7 sentences) describing a specific error you personally found in a set of financial statements, how you found it, and what the fix was

Your resume (PDF)

Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Shopify Dropshipping Specialist – Product Research, China Sourcing & Automation
description:
We are an Australian-based e-commerce business looking for an experienced Shopify Dropshipping Specialist to join our team.



We are seeking someone who has a strong understanding of product research, identifying profitable products, sourcing directly from Chinese suppliers and managing Shopify stores.



This is not simply a product uploading or virtual assistant role. We want someone who understands how to find products with genuine sales potential, evaluate competitors, negotiate with suppliers and build an efficient, largely automated dropshipping operation.



The successful candidate should be proactive, commercially minded and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Product Research & Trend Analysis



Research and identify trending, high-demand and potentially profitable products across different niches.



Analyse products using TikTok, Meta Ad Library, Google Trends, Amazon, AliExpress and other relevant platforms.



Identify emerging product trends before markets become oversaturated.



Research competitor Shopify stores, advertising strategies, pricing and product positioning.



Evaluate product demand, competition, profit margins and market potential.



Present researched products with supporting data, supplier links, costs and recommended selling prices.



Identify products suitable for the Australian market and potential international expansion.



2. Chinese Supplier Sourcing



Find reliable manufacturers, wholesalers and dropshipping suppliers through 1688, Alibaba, AliExpress and other Chinese sourcing platforms.



Communicate directly with suppliers and negotiate competitive product and shipping costs.



Compare multiple suppliers for each shortlisted product.



Assess supplier reliability, product quality, fulfilment times and shipping options.



Source private-label and custom-branded products where suitable.



Arrange product samples and coordinate quality checks where required.



Build long-term relationships with reliable Chinese suppliers and fulfilment agents.



3. Shopify Store Management



Upload and optimise products directly into our Shopify store.



Create professional product titles, descriptions, images, variants and pricing.



Organise product collections and ensure listings are optimised for conversions.



Manage product availability, pricing updates and supplier integrations.



Maintain a professional and consistent store presentation.



Identify opportunities to improve product pages and customer experience.



4. Dropshipping Automation & Fulfilment



Set up and manage Shopify integrations with suitable dropshipping suppliers and fulfilment platforms.



Automate product importing, inventory synchronisation, order forwarding and tracking updates wherever possible.



Experience with DSers, CJdropshipping, AutoDS, Shopify Flow or similar tools is highly regarded.



Monitor order processing, fulfilment issues, shipping delays and supplier performance.



Develop efficient workflows to minimise manual administration.



Identify opportunities to improve automation as the business grows.



5. Commercial Research & Reporting



Prepare regular reports outlining recommended products, supplier costs, shipping fees, potential selling prices and estimated margins.



Monitor competitor pricing and product performance.



Identify opportunities for product bundling, upselling and private labelling.



Recommend products based on research and commercial viability rather than trends alone.



Track product testing results and recommend which products to scale or discontinue.



Essential Requirements



Minimum 3 years' experience in Shopify dropshipping, product research or e-commerce operations.



Proven experience sourcing products directly from Chinese suppliers.



Strong understanding of 1688, Alibaba, AliExpress and Chinese fulfilment networks.



Demonstrated experience identifying and researching profitable products.



Good understanding of Shopify product management and dropshipping integrations.



Experience with product research and competitor analysis tools.



Understanding of product margins, shipping costs and e-commerce profitability.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organisational skills and ability to work independently.



Proactive approach to identifying opportunities and solving problems.



Highly Regarded



Experience working with Australian Shopify businesses.



Existing relationships with Chinese suppliers or fulfilment agents.



Experience with private-label products and custom packaging.



Experience setting up automated Shopify dropshipping stores.



Knowledge of TikTok and Meta advertising research.



Basic understanding of conversion rate optimisation and SEO.



Experience managing multiple Shopify stores.



Career Development



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business long-term.



The successful candidate will initially focus on product research, sourcing, Shopify management and automation.



As the business expands, there will be opportunities to progress into an E-Commerce Operations Manager role, with increased responsibilities, salary reviews and potential involvement in managing additional staff.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your CV and previous Shopify/dropshipping experience.



Examples of Shopify stores you have worked on and your specific responsibilities.



Three products you believe have strong potential in the Australian market, including supplier links, estimated landed costs and recommended selling prices.



Details of your experience sourcing products from 1688, Alibaba or other Chinese suppliers.



Examples of Shopify automation systems you have previously implemented.



Your expected monthly salary in AUD and availability to commence.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and paid practical assessment.



We are looking for someone who understands e-commerce, takes initiative and can help build a scalable, profitable dropshipping business.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Experienced (AU) Tax Accountant
description:

You will work from client source documents through to review-ready workpapers and lodgement-ready returns, with your work reviewed by our Australian-based accountants.

Key responsibilities

You will work across four entity types: individuals, companies, trusts and SMSFs.

Bookkeeping and data processing

• Reconcile bank, credit card, loan and clearing accounts

• Maintain accurate general ledgers and chart of accounts

• Prepare end-of-year adjustments, including accruals, prepayments and depreciation

BAS and IAS

• Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalments to the ledger

Tax returns

• Prepare workpapers that support every figure in the return

Financial reports

Workflow and communication

• Prepare clear queries for missing client information

• Respond to reviewer notes promptly and accurately

• Meet lodgement deadlines under the ATO tax agent program

Software and systems

Software Used for

Xero Bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, BAS

Xero Practice Manager (XPM) and Karbon Jobs, workflow, time recording

Simple Fund 360 SMSF financial statements, annual returns

CAS 360 Company secretarial, ASIC registers and documents

Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) Workpapers, reconciliations, correspondence

Adobe Acrobat Workpapers and preparing documents for signature

Experience and qualifications

Essential

• 2–3 years of Australian accounting and tax experience, gained in an Australian practice

• Experience preparing BAS and tax returns for individuals, companies and trusts

• Experience with SMSF accounts and annual returns using BGL SimpleFund 360

• Sound working knowledge of Australian tax law, GST, PAYG and Division 7A

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, commerce or a related field

• Experience with Xero Practice Manager XPM and Xero.

• Familiarity with ATO online services and the tax agent portal



Desirable

• Progress towards CA 

• Experience using Karbon

Skills and attributes

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in reconciliations and returns

• Clear written English for client queries and reviewer notes

• Able to manage several jobs at once and prioritise against lodgement deadlines

• Works independently with minimal supervision, and asks when unsure

• Takes reviewer feedback on board and applies it to future work

• Handles confidential client information with care

Working arrangements

• Full-time, remote offshore role

• Working hours overlap with Australian Eastern Time business hours for meetings and queries

• Reliable internet connection and a secure, private workspace

• Compliance with our data security and confidentiality policies

title: Senior PPC Manager & Brand Growth Strategist
description:
This is not a campaign-execution job. As a Senior PPC Manager you grow brands, oversee client accounts, and lead the way our team works with AI: building the tools and processes that take over repetitive work, and making sure what they produce is right. We are looking for someone who thinks, sees the bigger picture, and makes the whole team better.



🟢About Growster⚫️

Growster is a boutique Amazon growth agency based in Germany, founded by former aggregator brand owners. We work with 7- and 8-figure brands in the EU, UK and US. Our PPC Managers are also the account managers: they own the account and the client relationship. And we are moving our whole way of working to AI-assisted workflows that our own team designs, builds and checks.



🔘What you will do

✦Own a portfolio of brands end to end: growth, profit, margin, TACOS and the P&L, not only the ad console.

✦Go beyond bid management. Connect PPC with organic rank, listing, images, CTR, CVR, pricing, stock and promotions, and flag when the problem is not PPC at all.

✦Design and build AI-assisted tools and processes that optimize our workflows and improve the ones we already have, and get the team using them.

✦Oversee accounts with a sharp eye. Check AI output before it reaches a client or an account, correct what is wrong, and own the result.

✦Put analysis, prevention and growth ahead of busywork: spot problems before they show up in the numbers, fix the cause, and add a check so it does not happen again.

✦Lead client communication: clear, proactive and honest, including client calls, decisions and hard news. Share wins, problems and plans before the client asks.

✦Work as part of the team and raise its level: help teammates do things on their own, mentor newer PPC managers, share what you learn and build, and disagree openly and constructively. This matters as much as your own results.

🔘The person we are looking for

✦Analytical. You start from the data and you know which numbers matter.

✦High-agency. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.

✦Holistic. You think about the whole brand, not one channel.

✦AI-sharp. You build with AI and you catch it when it is wrong.

✦Honest. You say what is really happening, to the client and to us, including your own mistakes.

✦Collaborative and coachable. You make the people around you better, and you take feedback well.

🔘Who we are not looking for

🚫Checklist-only operators who follow steps without asking why.

🚫Yes-men. We want people who push back with reasons.

🚫Siloed specialists who only look at the ad console.

🚫Vanity-metric chasers who report impressions while profit slips.

🚫People who measure their value in hours and task lists. We do not need a daily "here is everything I did" report. We need the right things done and the wrong things prevented.

🚫Relays for AI. If you pass on what an AI says without checking it, this is not the role for you: every output that reaches a client or an account is yours.

🚫Part-time or freelance arrangements. This role is full-time.

🔘What success looks like after 6 months

✦You run a portfolio of brands end to end, and the clients see measurable growth.

✦At least one AI-assisted tool or process you built is used by the whole team.

✦Problems on your accounts are caught and prevented before clients notice them.

✦Teammates and clients come to you as a trusted voice.

What you bring

✦3+ years owning Amazon accounts, with growth you can prove: case studies with numbers, ideally on 7- or 8-figure brands.

✦AI workflows or tools you built (with Claude, ChatGPT, automations, scripts or sheets) that changed how you or your team work, and how you check what they produce.

/test/ICAR-16 and keep a screenshot of your score. It is information we collect, never a pass or fail filter.

 and upload your resume as a PDF.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time (9hrs), 8-hour shift with a 1-hour lunch break

Schedule: At least 5 hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours



About the Role



Triple Line Brands is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to support the day-to-day advertising work for consumer brands across their Amazon marketplaces.

This is an execution and analysis-focused role. You will carry out advertising plans set by a Senior Amazon PPC Strategist, build and optimize campaigns, maintain account hygiene, analyze performance data, and prepare accurate reports. The Strategist will own account strategy and higher-judgment decisions, while you will own the accuracy, quality, documentation, and timely completion of assigned PPC work.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, identifying inconsistencies, following structured processes, and translating clear performance targets into specific campaign changes.





What You’ll Do



Build, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns based on approved advertising plans.

Conduct keyword and product-targeting research, search-term analysis and harvesting, negative targeting, and routine account reviews.

Translate account-specific ROAS, ACOS, CPC, conversion, and budget-pacing goals into appropriate bid, placement, targeting, and budget adjustments.

Download, organize, analyze, and validate advertising and performance data using Excel or Google Sheets.

Review datasets, reports, and dashboards for missing information, duplicates, incorrect filters, formula errors, unusual results, and inconsistencies between sources.

Monitor sales, spend, TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, and other relevant performance measures.

Diagnose significant performance gaps or fluctuations, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions for Strategist review.

Compile, check, and submit PPC performance reports accurately and on time.

Maintain campaign hygiene, including organized structures, naming conventions, targeting, budgets, and campaign uptime.

Document campaign changes, actions taken, test progress, results, and follow-up items.

Support the Senior PPC Strategist with data preparation, reporting, account research, audits, and other PPC-related tasks that help brands progress toward their goals.

Flag risks, blockers, unclear instructions, data issues, or decisions outside your guidelines to the Senior PPC Strategist.

Apply department standards and share practical feedback that could improve campaign execution, reporting, quality assurance, and team workflows.





What We’re Looking For



At least three years of hands-on Amazon PPC management experience.

Experience independently managing multiple Amazon advertising accounts or marketplaces for established consumer brands with meaningful advertising spend.

Comfortable managing approximately 10 to 12 substantive brand-marketplace assignments when fully ramped, subject to account complexity and workload capacity.

Strong data analysis skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Experience reviewing and validating PPC datasets, reports, dashboards, or analytical models.

Ability to diagnose performance problems, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions.

Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, bidding, placements, budget management, keyword targeting, product targeting, search-term harvesting, and negative targeting.

Ability to translate quantified performance goals into specific campaign optimization actions.

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filters, and data validation.

Ability to identify reporting errors, inconsistencies between data sources, and meaningful changes in account performance.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to learn new brands, products, tools, and workflows quickly.

Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple accounts and evolving priorities.

Organized, dependable, receptive to feedback, and proactive about communicating risks, blockers, and opportunities to improve team processes.

Familiarity with Helium 10, SmartScout, My Real Profit, Atom11, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Amazon DSP experience is a strong advantage, with advanced proficiency preferred but not required.

Experience working remotely with US-based brands or cross-functional teams is an advantage.





Why Join Us



You’ll work on a varied portfolio of Amazon brands with clear strategic direction and defined performance goals. You’ll receive account-specific coaching from a Senior PPC Strategist and support from advertising leadership while strengthening your campaign execution, data analysis, and reporting skills.





Salary posted is negotiable

title: Amazon Virtual Assistant (VA)
description:
Job Summary



We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Amazon Virtual Assistant to support our Amazon Canada and US operations, with a primary focus on FBA reimbursements, inventory management, and listing maintenance.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and can independently investigate inventory discrepancies, identify reimbursement opportunities, troubleshoot listing issues, and coordinate resolutions with Amazon Seller Support.



We are looking for someone who is proactive, analytical, and capable of identifying operational issues and opportunities for improvement.



Key Responsibilities



1. FBA Reimbursements & Inventory Management

* Audit Amazon Seller Central to identify and recover eligible FBA reimbursements.

* Investigate inbound shipment discrepancies, missing or lost inventory, warehouse damage, customer returns, and inventory adjustments.

* Manage reimbursement cases, including documentation, follow-ups, escalations, and verification of approved claims.

* Monitor FBA and FBM inventory levels, identifying low-stock, out-of-stock, stranded, unfulfillable, and excess inventory.

* Investigate inventory discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions with internal warehouse teams and Amazon Seller Support.

* Monitor inbound FBA shipments, reconcile received quantities, and resolve receiving discrepancies.

* Identify opportunities to reduce inventory losses, storage costs, and other FBA-related expenses.



2. Amazon Listing & Catalog Management

* Create, update, and maintain product listings through Seller Central and bulk inventory file uploads.

* Troubleshoot inactive, suppressed, stranded, and restricted listings to restore product availability.

* Investigate and resolve listing errors, catalog inconsistencies, and SKU, ASIN, or FNSKU mismatches.

* Monitor listing compliance issues and coordinate with relevant teams to address restrictions and reinstatement requirements.

* Review listing health and identify issues affecting product visibility and availability.



3. Reporting & Operational Support

* Maintain accurate inventory reports, reimbursement trackers, and listing issue logs.

* Monitor unresolved cases and provide timely updates on progress, findings, and recommended actions.

* Proactively identify operational risks, reimbursement opportunities, and areas for process improvement.

* Perform other Amazon Seller Central-related tasks as assigned.



Qualifications



A. Required:

* At least *1 year of relevant experience* in Amazon Seller Central operations, preferably specializing in FBA reimbursements and inventory management.

* Hands-on experience managing Amazon Canada and US marketplaces.

* Strong understanding of FBA reimbursement processes, shipment discrepancies, inventory adjustments, and unfulfillable inventory.

* Experience creating and maintaining Amazon listings, troubleshooting catalog errors, and resolving inactive or suppressed ASINs.

* Familiarity with Amazon compliance-related listing restrictions and reinstatement processes.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for inventory analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent attention to detail, written communication, and ability to work independently.



B. Preferred:

* Experience using reimbursement tools such as Sellerise, GETIDA, or similar platforms.

* Familiarity with Amazon inventory reports, bulk listing uploads, and catalog error codes.

* Experience investigating complex inventory discrepancies and identifying additional reimbursement opportunities.



C. What We're Looking For



We value candidates who take ownership of their work, investigate issues thoroughly, and proactively recommend solutions rather than simply reporting problems.



The successful candidate should be comfortable managing multiple cases, prioritizing urgent issues, and helping improve the accuracy, efficiency, and overall health of our Amazon operations.

title: Marketing Agency Recruiter (Remote & Flexible Schedule)
description:

Our agency supplies content materials, instructions, and guidance. Creators publish slideshow videos through newly created TikTok accounts to promote various brands and products.



We are currently expanding our creator network in the Philippines and seeking motivated individuals to join our recruitment team. Your role will be to identify potential creators, introduce them to our opportunity, and help guide them through the application and onboarding process.



This is an opportunity to earn additional income while gaining experience in digital marketing, online recruitment, and creator management.



We have limited openings and are looking for dependable individuals who are ready to contribute consistently and grow alongside our agency.



Your Responsibilities:



- Research and identify Filipino individuals interested in earning money through TikTok slideshow content.

- Find potential recruits through
 groups, Reddit communities, 
 servers, TikTok, university networks, and freelancer platforms.

- Initiate conversations using our provided outreach templates, keeping your messages friendly and personalized.

- Explain the opportunity, answer questions, and assist interested individuals with their applications.

- Guide prospective creators through the required onboarding steps.

- Maintain an organized record of daily outreach, including contacts made and applications submitted.

- Provide daily updates covering your recruitment activity, progress, results, and any challenges.

- Remain active in team communications and reach out whenever you need assistance or clarification.



No Previous Creator Experience Required:



One important thing to understand is that the people you recruit do not need to be experienced content creators.



We welcome beginners, students, aspiring creators, and individuals who are simply interested in trying something new. They do not need an established TikTok account, a large following, or previous experience creating content.



Our agency provides the necessary content materials, instructions, and guidance to help creators get started.



Your goal is to find interested and willing participants, not just established influencers.



Who We're Looking For:



- Strong written English and the ability to communicate professionally.

- Comfortable starting conversations and reaching out to people online.

- Self-motivated, dependable, organized, and willing to learn.

- Able to follow instructions and work toward recruitment goals.

- Comfortable with consistent outreach and performance-based compensation.

- Willing to complete daily check-ins, track recruitment activity, and respond to messages promptly.

- A valid PayPal account for receiving payments.



Previous experience in recruitment, lead generation, sales, social media management, community management, or customer support is beneficial, but it is not required.



We value consistency, accountability, and a willingness to follow the process.



Daily Activity and Communication:



Although this position offers complete flexibility, daily participation and communication are required.



You are responsible for maintaining consistent outreach, reporting your progress, and staying in contact with the team.



We understand that you may have school, another job, or personal commitments. You are free to organize your schedule around those responsibilities, provided you remain active and communicate daily.



Please understand that regularly missing check-ins, failing to report progress, or becoming unresponsive to team messages may result in removal from the position.



We are looking for people who can work independently while remaining accountable to the team.



Schedule and Compensation:



Schedule: Fully flexible. There are no assigned shifts or fixed working hours. You d
 when to complete your recruitment activities, as long as daily outreach, reporting, and communication expectations are met.



Base payment: $25 per 30-day cycle, provided you successfully onboard at least 35 creators during that cycle.



In addition to the base payment, you earn performance-based compensation for every successfully onboarded creator. 



Performance-Based Earnings:



Your compensation is calculated progressively according to the following tiers:



- Creators 1–50: $1 per creator

- Creators 51–100: $2 per creator within this tier

- Creators 101+: $3 per creator within this tier



Each rate applies only to the creators in that tier. Higher rates do not apply to creators from previous tiers.



Minimum Recruitment Requirement:



To qualify for the additional $25 base payment, you must successfully onboard at least 35 creators within a 30-day cycle.



- Fewer than 35 completed onboardings: No base payment. You still receive $1 for each successfully onboarded creator.

- 35 or more completed onboardings: You receive the $25 base payment, plus all performance earnings calculated using the tiers above.



We encourage recruiters to aim for approximately 50 completed onboardings per cycle.



Each cycle runs for 30 days, and recruitment totals reset when a new cycle begins. Payments are issued through PayPal at the end of each cycle.



Please note that base-payment eligibility and continued participation are dependent on meeting recruitment expectations, maintaining daily communication, and submitting the required progress reports.



Opportunities for Growth:



As our agency continues to expand, we want to build a dependable recruitment team with opportunities for advancement.



Recruiters who consistently achieve strong results, demonstrate reliability, and communicate professionally may be considered for future positions such as Recruitment Manager or Client Manager.



We value people who take initiative, demonstrate accountability, and show potential to grow into greater responsibilities.



Application Process:



If you are interested in joining our team, please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Where would you find potential creators?



Identify three specific online groups, communities, or platforms where you would search for Filipino individuals interested in earning money by posting TikTok slideshow content.



Please provide actual examples rather than simply listing broad platforms such as
 or 
.



2. Why would you be a good fit for this position?



Tell us why you believe you would succeed in this role. Include any relevant experience and explain how you would organize potential leads, conduct daily outreach, track recruitment results, and maintain consistent communication with the team.



We are interested in understanding your approach, work ethic, and ability to stay organized and consistent.



 Flexible Side-Income Opportunity:



This position is intended for individuals looking to earn additional income while balancing school, employment, or other commitments.



It is not a traditional full-time or hourly part-time position. Your earnings are designed to supplement your existing income rather than replace your primary source of income.



You have the freedom to choose your working hours, but consistent daily activity and communication remain essential.



If you are motivated, reliable, willing to learn, and interested in being part of a growing US-based digital marketing agency, we encourage you to apply.



We look forward to hearing from you!
