title: Real Estate Lead Specialist / Lead Generation
description:
About the Role

We are a growing real estate investment team that finds, analyzes, and closes deals in markets including Jackson, MS and Daytona Beach, FL. We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented assistant to handle lead calling, deal underwriting, and day-to-day administrative work so the team can move faster on good deals. This is a self-directed role for a self-starter who can work unsupervised, manage their own day, and keep deals moving without reminders. Honesty and follow-through matter more to us than anything else, and this role is a strong fit for someone who wants to learn real estate investing from the inside.



What You'll Do

95% (1-3)



1. Lead Calling and Follow-Up

• Call leads from our GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM daily, following our scripts and talking points.

• Follow up consistently with every lead by phone and text until the lead becomes a deal or a clear no.

• Keep detailed notes on each lead in GHL and Google Sheets: what was said, condition, occupancy, timeline, price expectations, and the next step.

• Qualify sellers, agents, and wholesalers, and update lead status after every conversation.

• Label new contacts correctly in Quo (Realtor, Wholesaler, or Referral) and add the property address to the notes.

• Pass hot leads to the team quickly with a clear summary.



2. Finding Deals and Building Relationships

• Find deals in
 groups: monitor real estate investor, wholesale, and local market groups, reach out on promising posts, and follow up.

• Find deals online on Zillow and similar sites: search for target properties, flag the strongest, and contact the listing agents or owners.

• Build relationships with realtors and wholesalers so they send us their deals first: reach out regularly, respond quickly, and keep their contact details and preferences in the CRM.

• Post each deal you are actively working on Slack so the team knows it is yours.



3. Deal Underwriting  

• Pull comps, estimate the after-repair value (ARV), and review listing details, photos, and county records.

• Schedule GC walkthroughs get estimates and flag items that need a closer look.

• Run the numbers for each deal: purchase price, rehab, holding and closing costs, rent, cash flow, and returns for rental, BRRRR, and flip strategies, including DSCR and hard money scenarios.

• Summarize each deal in a short, consistent format with a recommendation and a suggested offer range.

• Follow our deal-claiming rules: post each deal you are actively working on Slack, and keep your claims current.



4. Day-to-Day Administration - 5%

• Manage the team's calendar, schedule showings and calls, and coordinate with agents, sellers, and vendors.

• Keep our deal tracker and Slack channels organized and up to date.

• Prepare and send offers, listing descriptions, and routine
s for review.

• Track documents such as contracts, disclosures, and title and closing paperwork, and follow up on missing items.

• Handle general admin tasks as they come up, such as data entry, research, and basic bookkeeping support.



What We're Looking For

Required

• A self-starter who works well unsupervised: you manage your own schedule, set daily priorities, and follow through without being chased.

• Clear, confident phone presence, with excellent English communication in speaking and writing.

• Comfort with numbers and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); able to learn underwriting math quickly.

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage many leads and deadlines.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and availability during [business hours / set schedule, time zone].

• Honesty and accountability: you tell us what is true, including when something went wrong.



Preferred

• Experience in real estate, wholesaling, investing, lending, or property management.

• Experience with a CRM such as GoHighLevel, and with tools like Slack, Zillow, and county property records.

• Familiarity with terms such as ARV, DSCR, BRRRR, hard money, and seller financing.

• Prior cold-calling or customer-service experience.



How We Measure Success

• Number of quality calls and conversations completed each day or week.

• Accuracy and speed of underwriting, and how well your numbers match real results.

• Clean, current CRM notes and deal tracker.

• Follow-through on tasks without needing reminders.

• Following the team's deal-claiming rules and keeping Slack accurate.

• Minimum of 4 deals to get under contract a month to start.

• 30 -90 day trial period. 



Compensation and Benefits

• Hourly or monthly pay range

• Performance bonus or deal-based incentive once full-time

• Hands-on training in underwriting and real estate investing

- Build commercial lists of churches, property managers, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants with wood-fired ovens.

- Call homeowners and businesses to book chimney inspections and estimates.

- Follow up on quotes that haven't been signed yet.

- Reach out to real estate agents, home inspectors, HVAC companies, and roofers who can refer jobs to us.

- Keep every lead, call, and outcome logged in the CRM.

- Check government bid websites once a week for masonry and chimney jobs.



*Social media*

- Run our
, Instagram, and Google Business Profile.

- Turn my job photos and phone videos into before and after posts and short reels.

- Post on Google Business Profile weekly and ask every finished customer for a review.

- Answer comments and messages the same day, and book anyone interested.

- Keep a simple monthly content calendar built around the seasons.



**What you need**

- At least 1 year of outbound calling to US customers. Home services, roofing, or real estate is a big plus.

- Clear, confident English on the phone.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, a CRM, Canva, and a simple video editor like CapCut.

- A quiet workspace, a good headset, and backup internet.

- Able to work US Eastern hours, mostly afternoons and early evenings, when homeowners pick up.



**Minimum expectations**

- At least 3 booked estimates per week.

- At least 3 social media posts per week.



If you fall below these two weeks in a row, we'll sit down and talk about it. If it keeps happening, it's not the right fit.



**Pay**

- 25 to 30 hours a week to start.

- Starting rate is $5/hr.

- **Raises are based on closed jobs you bring in.** Every month I'll review the paid jobs that came from your leads:



| Your leads bring in (paid jobs per month) | Your hourly rate |

|---|---|

| Starting rate | $5/hr |

| $8,000 | $6/hr |

| $18,000 | $7/hr |

| $30,000 and up | $8/hr (max rate) |



- You move up one step each month you hit the next level. Once you reach a rate, you keep it as long as you're meeting the minimum expectations.

- **5% commission on every job you bring in that closes and gets paid,** on top of your hourly rate. There's no cap on commission. If your leads bring in $18,000 in a month, that's $900 extra plus your raise.

- Commission is paid the month after the customer pays in full. A lead counts as yours if you found or booked it and logged it in the CRM under your name before I quote it.

- Full-time hours are open for the right person once the pipeline is running.



**How to apply (read carefully)**

1. Start your application with the word "Crown" and the city you live in. Applications that don't will not be read.

2. Send a 3 to 5 minute video, a Loom link is fine. In the video:

   - **Tell me about yourself and your background.** Where you've worked, what kind of calling and social media work you've done, and for what type of businesses.

   - **Tell me what you bring to the table.** What would you do in your first 30 days to get me more booked jobs? Be specific.

   - **Do a practice call.** Pretend you're calling a homeowner who just bought a house built in 1945, and book them for a chimney inspection.

3. Send 2 or 3 examples of social media posts or reels you've made for a business.

4. Tell me how many calls a day you made in your last calling job, and what dialer and CRM you used.

5. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test.



No video, no review. If your answers sound like they came from ChatGPT, I'll skip them. I want to see and hear you, not a robot. Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test before hiring.

Reference Video:**

contact me by

title: Operation & Media Specialist
description:
About Kipkeh Media



Kipkeh Media is a fast-paced digital media brand serving the Orthodox Jewish community. We produce and publish daily video stories, graphics, and visual content. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Operations & Media Specialist to help us coordinate media preparation, administrative tasks, and daily operations.



If you enjoy a mix of basic video editing, client coordination, and organizational work and thrive in an independent remote environment we would love to hear from you!



What to Expect

We value proactive problem solvers who take ownership of their work. This is a stable, full-time remote role (40 hours/week) designed for someone who manages their workload well without needing constant check-ins.



To ensure this role is a great mutual fit for your skills and our operational pace, all new team members begin with a two-week paid trial period at the agreed-upon hourly rate ($4.00–$6.00 USD/hr). During this time, we will work closely with you to help you learn our workflow, communication style, and quality standards.



Core Responsibilities



Content Preparation & Scheduling: Prepare and edit (basic cutting and editing) to verify daily videos and visual frames, ensuring correct sequencing, branding, and timely publication.



Basic Video Editing: Use CapCut and Canva to trim footage, remove dead space, resize content, and add approved logos, intros, or watermarks.

Client & Vendor Coordination: Collect creative assets, confirm deliverable requirements, and follow up on missing information or pending approvals.

Payment Tracking: Monitor outstanding client balances, follow up on unpaid invoices professionally, and report payment concerns to the appropriate manager.

Trackers & File Management: Maintain accurate Google Sheets, task trackers, dashboards, and shared Drive folders.

Task & Deadline Management: Track upcoming deadlines, organize your workload, and complete assignments efficiently.

Slack & Reporting: Monitor designated Slack channels, coordinate requests, and provide clear shift handoff notes and reports to the Operations Manager.

Issue Escalation: Report broken links, missing files, or unclear instructions promptly to prevent delays.



Position Details



Employment: Full-Time, Remote (40 hours per week)

Compensation: $4.00–$6.00 USD per hour, based on experience

Workdays: Sunday through Thursday

Available Shifts (Eastern Time):

Shift 1: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET

Shift 2: 3:00 AM–12:00 PM ET



(Each shift includes a one-hour break. Applicants must be able to work the assigned schedule consistently.)



Requirements

Experience: 1–2 years supporting US-based businesses, agencies, or founders in remote operations, administrative support, or media production.

Software Skills: Hands-on experience with CapCut, Canva, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail), and Slack.

Communication: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients and vendors.

Mandatory Hardware & Setup: A computer with at least 16 GB RAM and a suitable CPU for basic video editing. You must also have reliable primary internet, a backup internet solution, backup power (UPS, inverter, or generator), and a dedicated, quiet workstation.



How to Apply

Attention to detail is essential for this role. To apply, please send an
 following the exact steps below. Please ensure all shared links are set to "Anyone with the link can view."



1.
 Subject Line

Use exactly: [Your Full Name] – Operations & Media Specialist



2. Introduction & Schedule Confirmation

Confirm your acceptance of the two-week paid trial, and let us know which shift (Shift 1 or Shift 2) you are applying for.



3. Video Editing Samples

Include a Google Drive, Loom, or portfolio link containing 1–2 edited clips that demonstrate your ability to trim footage, resize video, and place logos/watermarks.



4. Resume, Tech & Workspace Verification

Please attach or link the following:

Your updated resume.

A viewable screenshot showing your computer's CPU and RAM (must show 16GB+).

A screenshot of a recent internet speed test (Primary /Backup if have).

A clear photo of your workstation (including your backup power source if visible).

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

title: Engagement Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly organised, proactive, and tech-savvy Engagement Operations Manager to support the day-to-day operations of a growing professional services business in Australia.







This is a newly created role combining executive assistance with operational management. You will oversee valuation matters from initial engagement through to final report preparation, coordinate communication with clients and lawyers, manage administrative workflows, and ensure every matter progresses efficiently and accurately.







You will also provide executive support by managing the principal’s inbox and calendar, while helping coordinate the launch and ongoing operations of a new online fixed-fee valuation service, expected to launch around January 2027.







This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership of processes, working independently, and using technology and AI tools to make operations more efficient. You will follow established procedures and templates, with key outputs reviewed by the principal. A detailed operations manual will be provided to support your onboarding.







Important: This is a coordination and operations role, not a valuation role. You will not be responsible for conducting valuations or providing valuation advice, and a finance background is not required.







Key Responsibilities



1. Valuation Matter Coordination



Manage valuation matters from initial engagement through to final report preparation and delivery.

Act as the day-to-day point of contact for clients and lawyers, providing clear, courteous, and timely communication.

Request, collect, organise, and track client documents, information, and responses required for each matter.

Prepare draft reports and related documents using established systems, templates, and AI tools.

Coordinate reviews with the principal, incorporate feedback, and track outstanding actions through to completion.

Maintain an accurate matter register, monitor deadlines, and follow up on outstanding information to keep matters progressing.

Ensure all files and records are organised, complete, and maintained in accordance with documented procedures.



2. Online Valuation Service Operations



Coordinate incoming jobs for the new online fixed-fee valuation service ahead of and following its planned launch.

Conduct a short welcome call with each customer to explain the process, confirm the information required, and establish next steps.

Manage customer communications, document collection, job tracking, and follow-ups throughout the service process.

Use established workflows and technology to ensure a consistent, professional customer experience.

Identify delays, missing information, and process issues, escalating matters when necessary.



3. Executive Assistance



Manage the principal’s inbox, prioritising
s, flagging important matters, and drafting responses where appropriate.

Maintain the principal’s calendar, coordinate appointments, and manage scheduling changes.

Monitor commitments, deadlines, and follow-up actions to ensure important tasks are not overlooked.

Provide general administrative and organisational support to help the principal focus on higher-value work.



4. Invoicing and Administrative Operations



Coordinate the preparation and issuing of invoices and the tracking of receipts.

Liaise with the external bookkeeper to ensure relevant records and supporting documents are provided promptly.

Maintain organised records of payments, invoices, and outstanding items.

Follow established administrative and financial processes, escalating discrepancies or issues to the appropriate person.



5. Process and Workflow Management



Follow the documented operations manual, checklists, templates, and established workflows.

Use available software, automation, and AI tools to prepare documents, organise information, and improve efficiency.

Maintain accurate records and ensure tasks are completed within agreed timeframes.

Identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, or opportunities to improve existing processes.

Work independently with minimal supervision while keeping the principal informed of progress, risks, and matters requiring decisions.



Skills and Experience



Essential Requirements



Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and courteously with clients, lawyers, and other stakeholders.

Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple matters, deadlines, and follow-up actions simultaneously.

Strong administrative and coordination skills, including document management, recordkeeping, scheduling, and
 management.

Confidence in learning and using new software, online systems, and AI-powered tools.

Ability to follow documented procedures accurately and consistently.

Strong initiative and problem-solving skills, with the judgement to work independently and escalate issues appropriately.

A proactive, dependable, and service-oriented approach to work.

Ability to work full-time during Sydney business hours.



Desirable Experience



Experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Client Services Coordinator, or in a similar administrative role.

Experience coordinating client engagements, professional services matters, legal administration, or document-heavy workflows.

Familiarity with AI tools for drafting, document preparation, research, or administrative automation.

Experience managing customer enquiries, onboarding, or service delivery workflows.

Exposure to invoicing, receipts, or coordination with a bookkeeper.



Experience in property valuation, finance, or accounting is not required.



What Success Looks Like



Valuation matters progress smoothly from engagement through to final report delivery, with deadlines and outstanding requirements consistently monitored.

Clients and lawyers receive timely, professional communication and know what is required at each stage.

Draft documents are prepared accurately using established templates and AI tools, with key outputs submitted for review.

The matter register, inbox, calendar, invoices, and supporting records remain organised and up to date.

Online valuation service customers receive a consistent and professional onboarding experience.

The principal can rely on you to manage day-to-day workflows with minimal supervision, raising only the issues that require their attention.

title: Client Success Manager & Recruitment Lead
description:
Role: Client Success Manager & Recruitment Lead

Engagement: Part-time, ongoing, fully remote 

Hours: 25 hours per week (5 hours a day, Monday to Friday): about 2.5 hours a day on client success and 2.5 hours on recruitment

Schedule: 9am to 2pm AEST

Reports to: Founder (day to day with Operations Manager)





* About Us

We are an Australian-owned business support company based on the Gold Coast. We are a growing remote team that supports Australian business owners with 10 out of 10 team members. We go deep on each business owner before we search, recruit from scratch, and onboard every new team member with structure.

We only hire 10 out of 10 team members. Not good enough, not "they'll do." We would rather take longer to find the right person than rush a hire that doesn't last.



That's why this role isn't about speed or volume. We want you to take your time. Get to know our clients and how their businesses really run. Nurture candidates, build genuine relationships and keep in touch with great people even when there isn't a role for them yet. Ask the extra question, check the extra reference and trust your instincts when something doesn't feel right.



Every new team member is hand-picked, not taken from a waiting list. We pay our team great rates, support them every step of the way, and treat people like people, not numbers.



We're a small, close-knit team that's growing quickly, and this role sits right at the heart of it.





* About the Role

You will lead recruitment for our team and look after our client relationships, working closely with our Founder. You will get to know each client's business well, find people who meet our 10 out of 10 standard, and bring fresh ideas to how we attract and assess talent.



Training and processes are provided. Do the job well, communicate proactively, and ask when unsure rather than assume.





* Key Responsibilities

Recruitment (about 2.5 hours a day)

- Build detailed role briefs for each new position on our team, based on how the client's business runs: the role, hours, skills, tools and the personality that will suit them

- Source, screen and assess candidates from scratch through LinkedIn,
 communities, referrals and our talent pool

- Interview thoroughly. Take your time, check references and trust your instincts.

- Shortlist and present only candidates who meet our 10 out of 10 standard, with clear, thoughtful write-ups

- Coordinate interviews and feedback, manage offers and hand new team members over to our Operations team for onboarding

- Keep in touch with strong candidates even when there isn't a role for them yet

Client Success (about 2.5 hours a day)

- Act as a main point of contact for your assigned clients, building genuine, long-term relationships

- Get to know each client's business, goals and working style so you can support them properly

- Hold regular check-ins to gather feedback, confirm satisfaction and keep each account on track

- Support structured onboarding so every new team member starts with clarity

- Own client retention: spot early signs of dissatisfaction, act on them quickly and escalate to leadership when needed

- Identify ways to add value, such as extra hours or additional support

- Receive and log client requests and coordinate with our Operations team on anything involving a current team member

Systems and Reporting

- Keep client and candidate records accurate in Ivorey, our applicant tracking system and Google Sheets

- Track open roles, candidate progress and hiring outcomes

- Submit start of day, end of day and end of week reports

- Escalate urgent client issues straight away rather than waiting for the next report

Working With the Team

- Work closely with our Founder on client relationships and hiring standards

- Work with our Operations Manager on team performance, replacements and handovers

- Bring fresh ideas to how we attract, assess and hire great people





* What You'll Bring

Must have

- At least [2] years in client or account management, ideally with a remote or virtual support business

- Proven end-to-end recruitment experience, from writing the brief through to a successful hire and follow-up

- Experience hiring remote team members for Australian or international businesses

- A sharp eye for talent. You can tell the difference between a candidate who interviews well and one who will actually be great in the role.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You write clear, warm, professional messages and you're confident on calls with business owners.

- Confidence using a CRM, an applicant tracking system and Google Sheets

- Strong organisation across several clients and open roles at once

- Availability during Australian business hours (AEST), Monday to Friday

Nice to have

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack or Jibble

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude to work smarter

- Background in virtual support or remote team management

- Experience sourcing candidates through 
 and
 communities

You'll thrive here if you…

- Have high standards and won't put forward a candidate you wouldn't hire yourself

- Are patient and thorough. You'd rather take an extra week than make the wrong hire.

- Enjoy building relationships with both clients and candidates

- Are honest with clients, even when the news isn't what they want to hear

- Spot problems early and raise them before they become bigger issues

- Ask when you're unsure rather than assume

- Take ownership and follow through without needing to be chased





* Tools You Will Use (training provided)

- Communication: Slack and WhatsApp

- Client records: Ivorey (our GoHighLevel platform)

- Recruitment: LinkedIn and our applicant tracking system

- Time tracking: Jibble

- Passwords: LastPass

- AI assistant: Claude

- Docs and sheets: Google Workspace





* Why Join TCC

- Long-term, stable work with an ongoing role, not a short-term contract

- Quality over quantity: time to recruit properly, not chase numbers

- Work directly with the Founder, who has been a VA herself and understands the job

- A supportive, close-knit team

- Room to grow into more hours and ownership of our recruitment process

- Clear systems and training from day one

- Your ideas matter







* How Success Is Measured

- Long-term hires and happy clients, not speed or volume.

- Client retention: Clients in your portfolio stay with TCC

- Hiring success: People you hire are still in the role and performing well at 90 days

- Shortlist quality: Candidates you put forward are interviewed and accepted

- Time to shortlist: A strong shortlist within an agreed timeframe, without cutting corners

- Responsiveness: Client requests acknowledged and actioned the same day

- Record accuracy: Client and candidate records kept complete and up to date

- Reporting: Daily and weekly reports submitted on time





* Working Arrangement

- Part-time, ongoing, fully remote, with no fixed end date

- 25 hours per week (5 hours a day, Monday to Friday) within AEST business hours, split evenly between client success and recruitment

title: Sales Strategist
description:
Job Description: Sales Strategist 



Overview 

Root Pages is a growing digital marketing agency looking for a thoughtful, relationship-focused Sales Strategist who knows how to listen, understand a business, and build trust before trying to make a sale. 



We are not looking for an aggressive salesperson or someone focused only on hitting outreach numbers. We want someone who is genuinely curious about people, asks good questions, communicates clearly, and takes the time to understand what a potential client actually needs. 



This is a hands-on sales role with significant ownership. You will help us improve how we generate leads, communicate with prospects, conduct sales conversations, follow up, and build long-term client relationships. 



We are specifically looking for someone who wants to grow with the company long-term. As Root Pages grows, this position is intended to develop into a senior sales leadership role with increased compensation, responsibility, and influence over our sales strategy. 



This is a fully remote position intended for candidates based in the Philippines.



Key Responsibilities 

• Build relationships with prospective clients and take time to understand their businesses, challenges, goals, and priorities 

• Conduct consultative sales conversations focused on finding the right solution rather than simply closing a deal 

• Ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and make prospects feel heard and understood 

• Develop and improve outbound strategies across
, LinkedIn, referrals, SMS, and other channels 

• Research prospective clients before outreach so communication feels relevant and personal 

• Identify ideal customer profiles, target industries, and strong-fit opportunities 

• Create and improve outreach messages, follow-up sequences, sales scripts, and processes 

• Manage prospect conversations from initial outreach through qualification and closing 

• Follow up consistently without being overly aggressive or impersonal 

• Clearly communicate our services, recommendations, pricing, and expectations 

• Maintain accurate customer records, notes, follow-ups, and pipeline information

• Identify patterns in prospect feedback and share insights that can improve our services, positioning, and sales process 

• Collaborate directly with company leadership on sales strategy and growth 



What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role is not measured only by the number of messages sent or calls made. 



We are looking for someone who can consistently create strong sales opportunities while leaving prospects with a positive impression of Root Pages, whether or not they ultimately become a client. 



Strong performance includes: 

• Building trust quickly with prospective clients 

• Understanding what a prospect actually needs before recommending a solution 

• Maintaining organized and thoughtful follow-up 

• Generating qualified opportunities and new revenue 

• Improving response, conversion, and close rates over time 

• Developing repeatable sales processes that still feel personal 

• Building relationships that can lead to long-term clients, referrals, and repeat business 



The Person We Are Looking For 



The right person is someone who can read a conversation, adapt their communication style, recognize when to listen rather than sell, and make people feel comfortable discussing their business. 



You should be: 

• Warm, professional, and easy to communicate with 

• Naturally curious about people and businesses 

• A strong listener who asks thoughtful follow-up questions 

• Empathetic and able to understand different personalities and communication styles 

• Comfortable building relationships over time rather than forcing an immediate sale 

• Confident without being pushy 

• Organized and dependable with follow-up 

• Comfortable receiving feedback and continuously improving 

• Able to take ownership without needing constant direction 

• Motivated by helping both the client and the company succeed 



Qualifications 

• Experience in sales, business development, account management, or a similar client-facing role 

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills 

• Demonstrated ability to build rapport and maintain professional relationships 

• Comfortable with outbound prospecting and handling rejection professionally 

• Ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups without losing the personal touch 

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools 

• Experience with digital marketing, websites, SEO, advertising, or service-based businesses is a strong advantage 



Compensation 



Base Pay: 

PHP 420–PHP 630 per hour 



Full-time, 40 hours per week. Starting rate will depend on experience, communication skills, and demonstrated capability.



High performers will have the opportunity to significantly increase their total compensation as their pipeline and sales volume grow. 



As the company expands, this role is expected to develop into a senior sales leadership position with additional compensation, authority, and responsibility. 



Work Arrangement 

• Full-time remote position 

• Long-term position 



Why Join Root Pages? 

We Value You & Your Time 



We believe people do their best work when they feel respected, supported, and trusted. We want to build a company where people can grow professionally without sacrificing their personal well-being. 



Work-life balance is encouraged and protected. 



Paid Time Off & Holidays 

• 12 Paid Philippine Holidays 

• 1 Paid Company Holiday 

• 11 Flexible Paid Vacation Days, accrued over time 

• 7 Paid Sick Days, accrued over time 



Flexible Scheduling 

Life requires flexibility. We accommodate reasonable schedule adjustments whenever possible. With advance notice and manager approval, we work together to support personal responsibilities while maintaining strong team performance. 



Weathering Storms Together 

During major storms, natural disasters, and extreme weather events, we provide additional flexibility and support. Your safety and the well-being of your family come first. 



Growth Opportunity 

We are building for the long term and want this person to grow with us. 



A successful Sales Strategist will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership of our sales department, help shape future sales processes, mentor future team members, and advance into a senior sales leadership role as Root Pages grows. 



How to Apply 



Please include: 

• Your resume 

• A short paragraph explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role 

• An example of a time when listening carefully to a customer or client changed how you approached a situation 

• An example of how you built or maintained a strong professional relationship 

• Your expected hourly rate in PHP 



We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate how they communicate with people, not just their sales numbers.

title: Sports Agent
description:
BECOME A SPORTS AGENT - Become the scouting eye of an American sports company.



Hi everyone, we’re looking for someone who REALLY knows sports to evaluate our athletes and get them in front of the right college coaches.



THE COMPANY

Athlete Zero helps high school athletes earn scholarships at US universities. We need someone who can tell exactly what level each athlete can play at and who wants to communicate with coaches to place our athletes on their teams.



THE ROLE

- Athlete Evaluator & Coach Outreach, full time and 100% remote

- You’ll analyze game and training film of our athletes and compare them against college rosters to determine where they can realistically play (D1, D2, D3, NAIA, JUCO)

- You’ll message college coaches about our athletes and convince them, using your own analysis of the film

- You’ll work directly with the families and help them d
 which offer is best for them



WHAT WE OFFER

- $400 - $600/month

- Real growth: if you prove yourself, there’s A LOT of room to grow inside the company

- The chance to directly change the lives of young athletes



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Ability to evaluate at least 3 of these sports: baseball, American football, soccer, basketball (volleyball and hockey are a plus)

- Solid knowledge of how college sports work in the US: NCAA/NAIA/JUCO divisions, recruiting calendars and contact rules, scholarships and roster sizes

- You can watch film and explain clearly what makes a player good, what’s missing, and which programs fit them

- Strong persuasive writing: you know how to get a coach’s attention in a few lines

- HIGH ability to speak, write and understand English

- Long-term commitment (several years)

- AGE DOESN’T MATTER



DON’T APPLY IF

- You can’t evaluate at least 3 of the sports listed above

- You don’t know how the US college sports system works

- You’re looking for something short-term

- You want to combine it with another job

- You need someone telling you what to do every step of the way



⚠️ If you live and breathe sports and want to be the reason an athlete gets their scholarship, this offer is for you ;)

Hours: Remote, full-time (about 40 hours a week), with 3-4 hours overlap with Eastern Time (Canada) every weekday.



About us

We're a growing health and supplement brand sold mainly on Amazon in Canada. We're a small team, we move fast, and Amazon is the core of our business. You'll work directly with the founder.



Who we're looking for

We care most about drive. We want someone driven and hungry to learn who learns fast and doesn't give up. We'll teach you how we do things. We can't teach grit.

You'll be a great fit if you:

- Teach yourself new things without waiting to be shown

- Keep going when Amazon Support says no the first three times

- Use AI tools every day and love trying new ones

- Care about small details: one wrong number on a shipment costs real money

- Give short, honest updates and ask when you're stuck

- Want a long-term main job and to grow into a bigger role

Please don't apply if you're looking for a part-time gig, a short project, or a second job next to another full-time one.



What you'll do

- Learn Seller Central fast, then check it every day: orders, account health, notifications, and open and follow up on Seller Support cases

- Help with inventory and FBA: update the stock tracker, build FBA shipments, print labels, chase inbound problems

- Update listings: titles, bullets, keywords, images, flat file uploads, and spot suppressed listings fast

- Help with PPC: add negative keywords, pull reports, flag campaigns that are spending with no sales

- Follow up with suppliers and our warehouse on dates, labels and shipments

- Use AI tools to draft cases, check listings, clean up data and speed up your own work

- Report: a short weekly update on what you did, the numbers, and what you'll try next



Requirements

- 1-2 years in a fast-paced, high-pressure role at a well-known company (a big retailer, e-commerce company, consumer brand, bank, telco, BPO or similar; busy retail at a known brand counts), OR a degree from a strong university (current students are fine if you can work full-time hours)

- Daily use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and you can show us how

- Comfortable in Google Sheets or Excel

- Good written English. Working English is required.

- Reliable computer, internet and power backup

You don't need Amazon experience. We'll teach you Seller Central. What we need is someone who learns fast and works hard.

Nice to have, not required: hands-on Amazon Seller Central work (FBA shipments, listings, PPC); other e-commerce (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, Daraz); inventory, logistics or supply chain work; Helium 10 or Jungle Scout; a business, supply chain, IT or engineering degree.



Your future here

- Long-term role on a growing brand, working directly with the founder

- Clear path to Amazon Operations Manager as you take on more

- Pay grows with your impact, with regular raise reviews



How to apply

 
 with the subject line starting "AMZ-OPS-JR" (applications without it won't be reviewed). Include:

1. Your CV, with your university and every job (company name, your role, dates). If you've done any Amazon or e-commerce work, say what you did

2. A short video of 3 minutes or less, with you on camera: introduce yourself, say why this role interests you, and tell us about something hard you taught yourself recently, and how you use AI in your work. Loom, an mp4, or a Google Drive link (set to "Anyone with the link") are all fine.

3. If you have one, a tracker, checklist or report you made (blur client names and numbers)



Our process

1. Application review

2. 30-minute video interview where you share your screen and show us your work, how you learn and how you use AI

3. 2-4 week paid trial with weekly goals

4. Full-time role

title: Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)
description:
Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: Up to $2,000/month depending on experience, with a clear path to increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Media is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We don't just run ads. We install and run a full growth team for the brands we work with: creative strategy, ad production, Meta media buying, landing pages, and retention, all on a clear weekly creative system. You'll work directly with Matt, ABG Media's CMO and founder (10+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience), and get trained in the systems we use to grow brands.



Our first and current client is a fast-growing supplement brand built on clean ingredients, no fillers, and real results. We're adding more brands. You'll start on that account and edit across more ABG client accounts as we grow. Video ads are a big part of how we grow every brand we work with.



Role Overview

We're looking for a video editor who knows how to turn raw creator footage into Meta ads that sell. Not pretty videos. Ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, and get people to click and buy.



You'll get briefs and scripts from our Creative Strategist, footage from our UGC creators, and performance feedback from our media buyer. But we don't want a button-pusher, and this role is a path to becoming a Creative Strategist. You'll also have real creative freedom: every week you'll pitch and make some of your own ad ideas, and the best ones get real budget behind them. When there's no creator footage, you'll build ads from B-roll, product shots, voiceover, and AI tools. When an ad wins, you'll recut it into more versions so it keeps winning.



We're an AI-forward team. We expect you to use AI tools heavily for research, ideation, production, and iteration: ChatGPT/Claude for research, hooks, and scripts; Midjourney/ChatGPT Images for concept frames; Kling, Runway, or Higgsfield for AI video and B-roll; AI voice and captions to move faster. Human judgment still owns the creative call and compliance.



Career Path: Video Editor to Creative Strategist

This is not a dead-end editing seat. Strong performers whose own ideas win in testing will be trained by the CMO into a Creative Strategist role: owning research, angles, briefs, and the weekly testing plan.



Key Responsibilities



Editing UGC & Direct Response Ads

- Cut creator/UGC footage into 15-60 second Meta ads based on our briefs and scripts.

- Pick the strongest moments from raw footage and pace them so they feel natural and keep attention.

- Add hooks, captions, music, sound effects, product shots, text overlays, and voiceover.

- Write and style native-looking captions (TikTok/Reels style, not overdesigned).



Variations & Sizing

- Create multiple hook/opening variations for each ad (3-5 openings per concept is normal).

- Deliver every ad in 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 for Meta placements.

- Recut and refresh winning ads with new hooks, new footage, new music, or new structures.



Your Own Creative Ideas

- Study competitor ads, the Meta Ad Library, TikTok, and customer reviews to spot hooks, formats, and trends worth stealing (in spirit, not copying).

- Pitch and produce 2-3 of your own concepts each week: your own hook, short script or voiceover, and edit. Run them by the Creative Strategist and they go into testing.

- Take a winning ad and remix it your way: new hook, new structure, new format.



AI & B-Roll Ads

- Build ads from B-roll, stock, product footage, and AI voiceover when no creator footage is available.

- Use AI tools daily (Kling, Runway, Higgsfield for video; ElevenLabs for voice; ChatGPT/Claude for scripts and hook variations) to fill gaps, speed up production, and iterate faster.

- Use AI for research and ideation too: mining reviews, summarizing competitor ads, and generating hook options before you cut.



Workflow & Feedback

- Hit roughly 20-40 finished ads per month (counting variations), depending on complexity.

- Turn around revisions quickly, usually within 24 hours.

- Keep files, project folders, and naming conventions organized so anyone can find any ad.

- Study our top-performing ads to understand why they work, and bring that into your next edits.



Compliance

- No disease claims, no cure or treatment claims, and no exaggerated results in captions, text overlays, or voiceover. If something in the footage crosses that line, flag it or cut it. We'll teach you our rules, but you need to care about following them.



Requirements



Must-Have

- 2+ years editing short-form ads or UGC content, with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads.

- Pro-level skill in Premiere Pro, CapCut (desktop), or DaVinci Resolve.

- Able to deliver 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 versions cleanly.

- Good written and spoken English: you can read a script and understand what it's really trying to say.

- Fast, reliable, and takes feedback well.

- Creative initiative: you have your own ideas for ads and can write a simple hook and short script yourself.

- Comfortable using AI tools every day as part of your workflow (or eager to get there fast).

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work.

- Able to work at least 3-4 hours a day overlapping US Central time.



Nice-to-Have

- Supplement, health, wellness, or beauty brand experience.

- AI tools: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Runway, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, or similar.

- After Effects or basic motion graphics.

- Experience with founder-style, mashup, or voiceover-led ads.

- Basic understanding of Meta ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR).



What We're Looking For

- A storyteller who can find the ad inside raw footage

- Obsessed with the first 3 seconds

- High output without sloppy work

- Owns their work: hits deadlines and communicates early if something is off

- Wants to get better every week based on real performance data



What We Offer

- Competitive pay based on experience, with a clear path to increases as you deliver and as we grow

- Ongoing training in our direct response ad systems

- Work directly with the CMO (10+ years in ecommerce) and our Creative Strategist

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency: start on one brand and add accounts as we sign new clients

- Clear briefs and scripts from a dedicated Creative Strategist

- Creative freedom to pitch and make your own ads, plus real performance feedback so you can see which ones win

- A clear career path into Creative Strategist: strong performers whose ideas win get trained by the CMO into strategy

- Or grow into a Senior Editor / Lead Editor role as we scale

- Remote work with a small, high-standard team



Application Instructions (Please Read)

Start your application with the words "CLEAN CUT" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. A short intro: years of experience, the brands or niches you've edited for, and your editing software.

2. REQUIRED SAMPLE: Links to 3 ads you edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio links; make sure they're viewable). Ads that ran on Meta are preferred. For each one, tell us in one line what you did (full edit, hooks only, captions, etc.).

3. The AI tools you use regularly, if any, and what you use each one for.

4. ONE AD IDEA OF YOUR OWN: for any DTC supplement or wellness product, give us a hook line and a 3-5 line script or shot list for an ad you'd make. Supplement-safe: no disease or cure claims.

5. Share your expected monthly pay (USD) based on your experience.

6. Your time zone and how many hours a day you can overlap with US Central time.



Applications without 3 sample ads and your own ad idea will not be considered. We'll review applications and shortlist within about a week. Finalists will complete a short paid test edit using footage we provide before we make an offer.



HOW TO APPLY: In your application, explain why you're an expert in performance ads. Name the brands or products you've edited for, tell us which of your ads earned real spend and why they worked, and share any results you know. Ads Manager spend screenshots are a plus but not required. Also tell us where you learned your skill and how you keep learning.

RESPONSIBILITIES –

REQUIREMENTS –

- Familiarity with Canva and social media trends.

- Strong creative instincts and attention to detail.

- Good English communication skills.

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

- Organized, dependable, and comfortable receiving feedback.



Experience with Lightroom, Photoshop, podcasts, or long-form editing is a plus, but not required!



Most importantly, I'm looking for someone who is creative, proactive, eager to learn, and genuinely passionate about content creation.



HOW TO APPLY – To be considered, please
 the following to 



1. Resume:

- An updated resume highlighting your previous work experience and relevant skills.



2. Portfolio:

- At least 2–3 examples of short-form videos you've personally edited.

- Additional graphic design, photo editing, or long-form examples are welcome!



3. Unedited Video Introduction (2 Minutes Maximum). I'd love to get to know the person behind the resume! Please record a short, casual video introducing yourself and sharing:

- A little about yourself and your background.

- What sparked your interest in video editing and content creation.

- What you enjoy most about being creative.

- Why this opportunity interests you.



Please do not edit your introduction video! No fancy equipment, transitions, or effects needed. I'm simply looking to get a genuine sense of your personality, communication style, and enthusiasm!



4. A Few Quick Questions:

- What video editing and design programs do you use?

- How many hours per week are you available?

: 
  

Subject Line: Creative Content Assistant Application – Your Full Name

ONE LAST THING –  

I'm not looking for someone who knows everything. I'd rather find someone with great creative instincts, a positive attitude, strong communication skills, and a willingness to learn. My goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who can grow alongside me as my business and creative projects expand, ideally transitioning this role into a full-time opportunity as we grow. If you're someone who genuinely loves social media, notices the little details in videos, and gets excited about bringing creative ideas to life, I'd love to hear from you! 😊 I'm excited to find someone I can create and grow with!

This is not a beginner role. We work at a high creative standard and we’re looking for someone who can match that level from day one.



Your tools

All AI tool subscriptions and credits (such as Higgsfield) are at your own expense. As a professional AI ad editor, your tools are part of your craft, just like editing software. Already actively working with Higgsfield is a strong plus.



Where this can lead

We see this as an investment on both sides. We start small, but we think big. Boelou has big ambitions, and we’re building a team of editors who grow with us. Editors who prove themselves can grow into guaranteed 40-hour work weeks and earn thousands of euros per month.

You’ll also get access to Hadsway, our AI dashboard. Every week, we review ad performance together at a detailed level, analyzing metrics such as hook rate, hold rate and CTR. The goal is simple: to make you a better editor with every ad you make. We value loyalty, and we invest in the people who stay with us.



What you’ll do

You’ll create high-quality video ads for paid social, including AI-generated ads, cinematic-style ads, and AI talking head videos. Every ad needs to look premium, feel intentional, and be built to perform.



What we’re looking for



Proven experience creating AI ads (AI visuals, AI video, AI talking heads)

Strong skills in cinematic-style editing: pacing, color, sound design, transitions that serve the story

Familiarity with current ad trends on Atria and an understanding of what makes ads perform

A sharp eye for detail. Small mistakes are not acceptable in our ads.

Reliable, communicative, and able to work from a briefing independently



Your setup

Your equipment must be high quality and built for an intensive workload. On average, an ad takes 7 to 10 hours of editing, and your setup should handle these sessions and heavy video files smoothly, without lagging, crashing or slow rendering. Please only apply if your setup meets this standard.



Please note: We are not interested in surface-level edit styles (basic templates, generic captions, stock-footage slideshows). Only apply if you are 100% convinced you can keep up with a high creative standard.



How to apply

We don’t want to see a portfolio. Instead, we want to see the single best AI ad you have ever made. That one ad tells us more than a full portfolio.

Name

Years of experience

Direct link to your best AI ad

 address

WhatsApp number



Important: please send only what we ask for. We receive a large number of applications, and a fixed format allows us to review every applicant quickly and fairly. Applications that include additional information (portfolios, CVs, multiple links, long introductions) will not be considered.



Next step

If you’re selected, you’ll receive an
 from me personally (not through OnlineJobs). This

If you don’t receive an
 within 1 week, you have not been selected.



Compensation

The hourly rate will be discussed with selected candidates.

title: Senior Structural Steel Estimator – Australian Projects
description:
Sydney-based construction company specialising in structural steel supply, fabrication and installation across residential, commercial and industrial projects.



We are looking for an experienced Structural Steel Estimator to join our team and assist with our growing tendering and project workload.



We need someone who is switched on, organised, technically capable and able to work independently. You must have a strong understanding of structural steel and be confident reviewing drawings, identifying the full scope of works and preparing accurate estimates.



We already have our own estimating spreadsheets, pricing schedules, proposal templates and established systems. You will be trained in our processes, but we expect you to bring solid structural steel estimating experience and the ability to manage projects with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



Structural Steel Estimating & Take-Offs



Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to understand the complete steel scope.



Prepare accurate material take-offs, including steel member sizes, quantities, lengths, weights and total tonnage.



Identify structural steel components including UB, UC, PFC, RHS, SHS, CHS, plates, cleats, connections and associated materials.



Identify fabrication, welding, surface treatment, transport and installation requirements.



Prepare detailed cost estimates using our existing Excel spreadsheets and pricing templates.



Identify discrepancies, missing information and potential variations within tender documentation.



Understand project specifications, inclusions, exclusions and site requirements.



Review revised drawings and identify changes in steel quantities and project costs.



Tendering & Client Correspondence



Review new tender enquiries and assess project requirements.



Manage and monitor current tenders, outstanding quotations and submission deadlines.



Prepare professional pricing proposals using our existing company templates.



Correspond with builders, contractors and clients regarding tender enquiries, drawing clarifications and pricing submissions.



Follow up outstanding quotations and assist with securing new projects.



Prepare supplier enquiries and obtain material and subcontractor pricing where required.



Maintain organised tender records, pricing registers and project documentation.



Work closely with our Sydney-based Project Manager to finalise estimates and proposals before submission.



Essential Requirements



Minimum 5 years' experience in structural steel estimating or a closely related steel fabrication environment.



Previous experience estimating structural steel projects for Australian builders or fabricators is highly preferred.



Strong understanding of structural steel fabrication, connections and installation methods.



Ability to independently interpret structural and architectural drawings.



Experience preparing detailed steel take-offs and calculating tonnage.



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.



Good understanding of Australian structural steel standards and industry practices.



Strong written and spoken English, particularly for professional client correspondence.



Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management.



Ability to work independently, manage multiple tenders and meet deadlines.



Reliable computer and internet connection.



Highly Regarded Skills



The following experience would be a major advantage:



Tekla Structures modelling and structural steel detailing.



Preparing structural steel shop drawings and fabrication drawings.



Experience producing material take-offs directly from Tekla models.



Understanding steel connection detailing and design coordination.



Experience with AutoCAD, Bluebeam or other estimating software.



Previous experience working directly with Australian structural steel fabricators.



Experience pricing both supply-only and supply-and-install steel packages.



Candidates with both structural steel estimating and Tekla detailing experience will be highly regarded.



Career Development



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position with the opportunity to grow alongside MIREK Construction.



The successful candidate will initially focus on estimating, material take-offs, tender management and preparing pricing proposals.



As the business expands, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility, including managing the estimating department, coordinating junior estimators and progressing into a Senior Estimator or Estimating Manager position.



Salary reviews and promotion opportunities will be based on experience, performance and demonstrated capability.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your CV and details of your structural steel estimating experience.



Examples of previous structural steel take-offs or estimating spreadsheets.



Details of your experience working on Australian construction projects.



Any experience with Tekla Structures, shop drawings or steel detailing.



Your expected monthly salary in AUD.



Your availability to commence work.



Please also answer the following questions:



Have you previously estimated structural steel supply-and-install projects in Australia?



Can you independently review a complete structural drawing package and identify all steel members and associated works?



Have you prepared client pricing proposals and managed tender correspondence?



What software do you currently use for steel take-offs and estimating?



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an online interview and paid practical assessment.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, understands the construction industry and wants to become a valuable long-term member of our team.

title: Funding & Customer Success Specialist (US Small Business Clients, US Hours)
description:
Truence is a US fintech company (Plano, Texas). We help Shopify sellers, Amazon sellers and service businesses get funded and grow. Business owners connect their store, ad and bank accounts to Truence, see a verified picture of their business, and when they are ready, we connect them with our lending partners for working capital. Truence is not the lender; our partners make the funding decisions.



Most of our new customers come to us because they want funding. We are hiring our first Funding & Customer Success Specialist to be the person who takes those business owners from first call to funded and keeps them growing after.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Respond quickly to new funding leads (US business owners who applied through our ads) by phone, video and

- Explain how Truence works and walk each owner through connecting their store, ad and bank accounts on a video call

- Get each business funding-ready: confirm their information is complete, check it against our lending partners' basic requirements, and collect what is missing

- Submit ready applicants to the right lending partner and follow up with both sides until the business gets an answer

- Keep every lead and application moving in our CRM: status, next step, follow-up date. Nothing goes cold.

- After funding, check in with your accounts so they keep using Truence, and spot owners ready for their next round

- Report what owners and lenders ask for, so it shapes what we build



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on calls and video with US business owners every day.

- 2+ years with US clients in one of these: small business loans, merchant cash advance, revenue-based financing or other business funding (strongly preferred); or SaaS customer success, onboarding or account management

- Comfortable on the phone with business owners, following up persistently and professionally

- Organized: every lead tracked, every next step sent, nothing dropped

- Experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central or e-commerce sellers is a strong plus

- Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho is a plus

- Discreet with financial information. You will see sensitive business data and must follow our security rules.



SCHEDULE

- Full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

- Must work US Central Time business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT)

- Quiet workspace, reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and a good headset and webcam



PAY

- Monthly salary paid in USD, plus commission on businesses you help get funded and customers you keep. Details are shared in the interview.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "TRUENCE" so we know you read this post.

2. Tell us about your experience with business funding or onboarding US clients, including the company and your role.

3. Include a link to a 1 to 2 minute video or voice recording introducing yourself in English.



Applications without these three items will not be reviewed.

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

*Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment



Requirements:

-3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

-Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

-Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

-Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

-Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

-Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for email & mobile marketing

-Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

-Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

-A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

-Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

-Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

-Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

-Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

-Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

title: Printify & Shopify Product Listing VA

- Prepare exhibits, chronologies, deposition materials, and hearing or trial preparation files.

- Track case activity and applicable court rules and deadlines.
