- Start: part-time, 5–10 hours per week

- Hours increase based on client needs and the quality of your work — strong performers grow with us toward 15–25+ hours per week and a long-term home here

- Pay: $6/hour, paid biweekly via Wise, always on time



**Who we are looking for**

- 3+ years of bookkeeping experience, including 2+ years working in QuickBooks Online every week (QBO certification is a strong plus)

- **Job costing experience is required** — you know how to track costs against jobs/projects and keep job profitability accurate

- **Trucking industry experience is required** — fuel expenses, per-truck costs, trucking invoicing and paperwork are familiar territory

- Proven reconciliation experience — you can take a messy bank feed and make it tie out

- **You take initiative.** You plan your own week from your task list, you flag problems before you're asked, and you suggest a better way when you see one

- **You are honest and transparent about your work.** We track time in Clockify with clear descriptions of the actual task, and work is logged in Asana the same day it's done. Hours must match completed work — this is a firm standard of our team, and it's how we protect everyone's pay, including yours

- Confident spoken and written English — comfortable talking with US clients in meetings and recording end-of-month statement summaries on video

- Accurate, detail-obsessed, and unembarrassed to say "I don't know — let me find out"

- Reliable computer, stable internet, and backup power — this work cannot stop for outages

- Comfortable working Philippines hours that overlap partly with US Central Time for team check-ins



**How to apply**

Start your application with the word **LEDGER** so we know you read this fully, then answer these three questions briefly:

1. How many years have you worked in QuickBooks Online, and what kinds of businesses were the books for? Include your trucking and job-costing experience.

2. Describe the last reconciliation you completed: which account, how far behind it was, and how you got it to tie out.

3. Why does starting part-time and growing with one company long-term fit what you want right now?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a **short paid trial task** before any offer — we pay for trial work, always.



If you are looking for a stable, long-term seat with a team that values honesty, initiative, and doing things right — we would love to hear from you.

Collaboration & Future Leadership

title: Experienced Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We're a marketing agency looking for a strategic, creative digital marketer to help our clients grow. This is a marketing role at heart: you'll shape strategy, create content people want to engage with, run social media, and use HubSpot to turn attention into qualified leads.



We want someone who sees the bigger picture. You should be able to look at a business, understand its audience and goals, and d
 which channels, messages, and campaigns will move it forward. Then you'll help bring that plan to life with fresh ideas and consistent execution.



AI should already be part of how you work. We're looking for someone who uses it to research faster, brainstorm better, and produce quality work at scale, while applying their own judgment to everything that goes out the door.



A Note on Fit

This is not a web development or website maintenance role. Our web team handles builds, updates, and technical fixes. We're looking for a marketer who leads with strategy and creativity, someone who d
 what we should say, to whom, and where, and then makes it happen. If your background is mainly in development or site updates, this role likely isn't the right match.



What You'll Do - Marketing Strategy

Get to know each client's business, customers, competitors, and goals.

Build marketing strategies that tie content, social,
, and search together around clear priorities.

Recommend where to focus effort, what can wait, and how we'll measure success.

Present ideas and results to clients with confidence, in plain English.



Content Creation

Develop content ideas and campaigns that reflect each client's brand voice and speak to their audience.

Write and edit blog posts,
s, newsletters, social posts, case studies, and landing page copy.

Brief designers and writers with clear direction, and review their work for quality and consistency.

Repurpose content across channels to get more value from every piece.



Social Media

Create monthly social media content calendars aligned with each client's strategy and campaigns.

Schedule posts across platforms such as LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and X.

Monitor accounts, engage with comments and messages, and flag issues or opportunities quickly.

Track performance and adjust the approach based on what's working.



HubSpot Implementation & Strategy (Go High Level Not Applicable)

Set up and optimize HubSpot for clients, including contacts, lists, segmentation, forms,
s, and workflows.

Design lead nurturing and follow-up sequences that move prospects toward a sale.

Make sure inquiries reach the right person and receive timely follow-up.

Build reports and dashboards that connect marketing activity to leads and revenue.



SEO & AEO

Apply SEO best practices to content, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and internal linking.

Shape content so it can be found and cited by AI-driven search and answer engines (AEO).

Use tools such as Ahrefs, or SE Ranking to find opportunities and track progress.

Work with our web team when technical fixes are needed; you set the direction, they handle the build.



Reporting & AI Workflows

Prepare regular reports that explain what changed, what it means, and what we should do next.

Use AI tools for research, ideation, drafting, and analysis, and check all output before it's shared.

Build reusable templates and workflows that help the whole team work faster and more consistently.



What We're Looking For

Five or more years of digital marketing experience, with campaigns or programs you've owned from strategy through results.

A strategic thinker who can connect marketing activity to business goals and explain the "why" behind recommendations.

A creative mind with strong ideas for content, campaigns, and social media that stand out.

Excellent writing skills and the ability to adapt tone and voice for different brands and audiences.

Experience planning, scheduling, and managing social media including community engagement and performance tracking.

HubSpot experience with workflows, segmentation, forms,
 campaigns, and reporting. HubSpot certifications are a plus.

Solid working knowledge of SEO and a clear understanding of how AI search and answer engines are changing content strategy.

Comfort with GA4, Google Search Console, and at least one SEO platform such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or SE Ranking.

Established AI workflows you can demonstrate and explain, including how you check output for accuracy.

Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to lead conversations with US-based clients.

Experience managing several clients or projects at once. Agency experience is a strong plus.

Good judgment, attention to detail, and a dependable approach to remote work.



Nice to Have

Google Ads experience, including campaign setup, keyword targeting, budget management, and performance optimization.

Familiarity with paid social advertising on LinkedIn or Meta.

Experience with HubSpot Content Hub, Google Tag Manager, or social scheduling tools such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or HubSpot Social.



Schedule & Working Arrangements

This is a remote position based in the Philippines. You'll need consistent availability during US Eastern business hours for team collaboration, client meetings, and timely communication.



We'll agree on the exact schedule before hiring; it will include evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. You'll also need reliable internet, a suitable space for video calls, and backup arrangements for power or connectivity interruptions.



How to Apply

Send your résumé, expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos, and your availability during US Eastern business hours. Please also include:



A marketing strategy or campaign you developed: the business, what you recommended, and the results.

Samples of content you created, such as blog posts,
s, or social media posts.

A social media calendar you built, or an example of an account you managed and how it performed.

An example of HubSpot work you've done, such as a workflow, nurture sequence, or report.

Two examples of how you use AI at work, how you check the output, and what it has improved.

We care most about what you can show us: the ideas you brought, the decisions you made, and what you learned from the results.

title: Funnel Designer (Remote)
description:
If you’re tired of being treated like a “make-it-pretty” designer — handed random briefs, unclear goals, and last-minute requests with no performance context — this role is built differently.



At Accel Scaling, the Funnel Designer gig is intentionally designed around conversion, clarity, and flow. You won’t just design assets in isolation; you’ll design complete funnel experiences — from first touchpoint to final conversion — with clear intent behind every section, layout, and visual decision.



You’ll work with a fast-moving performance team that respects design as a growth lever, not decoration. Inputs are structured, goals are defined, and your work is measured by how well it supports revenue outcomes — not how many revisions you survive.



This is the role for someone who wants ownership over how funnels look, feel, and convert.



This is a remote gig.



===



Why You’ll Love This Gig:

- Design with purpose. Every page, section, and component has a clear conversion goal.

- Clear context. You’ll know what the funnel is selling, who it’s for, and what action matters most.

- Creative autonomy. You own your design approach and execution. What matters is performance-ready output.

- AI-positive environment. Use tools like Figma AI, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or other AI-assisted workflows — as long as results are accurate, clean, and intentional.

- Skills over credentials. We care about your thinking, your execution, and your results — not paper qualifications.



===



You’re Our Ideal Candidate If...



- You think in flows, journeys, and systems, not just individual pages.

- You understand visual hierarchy as a conversion tool — guiding attention, pacing information, and reducing friction.

- You can translate messaging into clear, structured page layouts that support persuasion.

- You enjoy feedback, iteration, and improving designs based on real-world usage.

- You stay aware of design trends, but prioritize what actually converts.





===



What You Won’t Be Doing



- You won’t manage clients or handle client-facing communication.

- You won’t plan marketing campaigns or manage project timelines.

- You won’t be responsible for long-form copywriting (you’ll work from approved copy / short form placeholders you draft).



===



What You’ll Do



1) Funnel & Page Design



- Design high-converting funnel assets, including:

- Opt-in pages

- Sales pages

- Webinar registration pages

- Thank-you pages

- Upsell / downsell pages

- Translate funnel strategy into clear, structured visual layouts.

- Ensure logical flow, visual clarity, and strong call-to-action emphasis throughout.



2) Image Ads



Create high-converting image ads alongside our Head of Creative Strategy



3) Conversion-Focused Visual Systems



- Build modular design systems that scale across funnels.

- Create reusable sections, templates, and components to speed up deployment.

- Ensure consistency across multi-step funnels while adapting visuals to intent.



4) Performance & Iteration Support



- Design multiple visual variations to support A/B testing.

- Collaborate with copy and performance teams to refine layouts based on feedback and results.

- Make fast, clean design updates without breaking the overall funnel structure.



5) Creative Quality & Execution Excellence



- Maintain high standards for spacing, hierarchy, typography, and readability.

- Ensure all designs are export-ready and optimized for web performance.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist to support a U.S.-based pest control and lawn care business in Florida.



The ideal candidate should have proven experience in creating, managing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, increase customer conversions, and drive measurable business growth.



This is not a traditional social media management or administrative Virtual Assistant role. We are looking for someone who can independently manage advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, analyze marketing performance, develop effective strategies, and take ownership of marketing results.



SHIFT:

 Part time flexible hours and overlap to catch up during US hours





DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Create, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns across
, Instagram, Google Ads, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

- Develop targeted marketing strategies for residential customers, commercial businesses, homeowners associations (HOAs), and golf courses.

- Create and repurpose marketing content for different platforms and target audiences.

- Use AI tools to create graphics, videos, advertisements, captions, and other marketing materials.



2. Lead Generation & Marketing Analytics

- Develop and implement strategies to generate qualified leads and increase customer conversions.

- Monitor key performance metrics, including cost per lead, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, and return on advertising investment.

- Track leads and sales generated from different advertising platforms and customer segments.

- Use Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and UTM tracking to measure campaign results.

- Conduct A/B testing and continuously optimize campaigns based on performance.

- Recommend adjustments to advertising budgets to improve campaign effectiveness.



3. Website Optimization & Competitor Research

- Evaluate website performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

- Research competitors' SEO strategies, keywords, website traffic, and advertising campaigns.

- Recommend improvements to landing pages and website content to increase lead generation.

- Improve local SEO and Google Business Profile visibility to attract potential customers.



4.
 Marketing & Automation

- Create and manage automated
 marketing campaigns, drip sequences, and customer follow-ups.

- Develop seasonal promotions, referral campaigns, and customer reactivation strategies.

- Implement upselling and cross-selling campaigns to generate additional revenue from existing customers.

- Create targeted
 campaigns for commercial businesses, HOAs, and golf course prospects.

- Monitor
 campaign performance, customer engagement, conversions, and generated revenue.



5. CRM & Marketing Automation

- Manage marketing campaigns and track leads using CRM and marketing automation platforms.

- Support the integration of marketing tools with existing business management systems when possible.

- Use automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar platforms to streamline workflows.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes and reduce repetitive manual tasks.



6. AI Marketing & Performance Reporting

- Use AI tools to support campaign planning, content creation, competitor research, reporting, and workflow automation.

- Recommend tools and strategies to improve marketing efficiency and overall campaign results.

- Provide weekly updates on marketing activities and campaign performance.

- Prepare monthly performance reports covering advertising expenses, qualified leads, customer conversions, generated revenue, website performance, and recommendations for improvement.



QUALIFICATIONS

- Proven experience managing successful paid advertising and lead generation campaigns with measurable results.

- Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager,
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube marketing.

- Experience managing both B2B and B2C marketing campaigns.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing analytics, conversion tracking, and lead attribution.

- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and UTM tracking.

- Experience with SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and website conversion improvements.

- Experience creating and managing
 marketing campaigns, drip sequences, and marketing automation workflows.

- Familiarity with AI marketing tools for content creation, data analysis, and process improvement.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to work independently, manage campaigns proactively, and recommend strategies to improve marketing results.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Previous marketing experience in pest control, lawn care, landscaping, property management, or similar service-based businesses.

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is an advantage but not required.

- Familiarity with PestPac or similar business management systems.

- Experience using Zapier, Make, or other CRM integration and marketing automation tools.



IMPORTANT NOTE

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist who can independently plan, execute, monitor, and optimize marketing campaigns.



Applicants must have hands-on experience generating qualified leads, managing advertising budgets, tracking campaign performance, and improving return on investment.



This position requires someone who is proactive, analytical, results-oriented, and capable of delivering measurable business growth with minimal supervision.





If you believe you're a good fit for this position, please submit the following:



1. Your updated resume in PDF format.

2. A screenshot of your computer specifications and internet speed.

3. Your WhatsApp number for communication.



Please use "Marketing" as the subject line of your application.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Remote AI Virtual Assistant (Automation) | $1,250/Month
description:
📹 YOU MUST SEND A LOOM VIDEO TO BE CONSIDERED. We will not open applications that are missing a Loom video link. The details on what to record are in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this post.



Are you the person who builds an automation the moment a task starts to feel tedious? Our growing insurance district in the U.S. needs an AI Virtual Assistant who can design AI workflows that give our leaders hours back every week, and who also keeps our everyday office tasks moving.



There is no selling in this role. We need someone who uses AI at a truly advanced level, not someone who only asks a chatbot the occasional question. You will get to know how our team works, find where the most time is being lost, and build real solutions with Claude, Google Workspace, and the meeting and tracking tools we already use. Half of the job is building, half is hands-on support, so it suits someone who likes both.



Your Day to Day

- Study our team's routines and identify the repetitive, manual work that AI can handle instead

- Build and maintain Claude Projects, Skills, and prompt templates for work we do again and again, like
 drafts, SOPs, reports, and summaries

- Turn Read.ai meeting recordings and transcripts into action items, recaps, and follow-ups people can use right away

- Clean up and automate our Google Sheets trackers and reports so they stay current with less manual updating

- Keep our AI tools organized, write clear documentation for everything you build, and help teammates get comfortable using it

- Take on daily requests as they arrive and spot what needs doing before anyone has to ask



What You Bring

- 2 to 3 years of virtual assistant experience, including at least 1 year building AI workflows for a business (using AI now and then to help write something does not count)

- Strong prompt engineering skills: you write detailed, multi-step prompts with clear instructions, examples, and output formats, and you keep refining them until the results are consistent

= A track record of building reusable AI setups that a team depends on, such as Claude Projects or Skills, custom GPTs, or something similar

- Hands-on experience connecting AI to everyday tools using Zapier, Make, n8n, or Google Apps Script; experience with APIs or MCP integrations is a big advantage

- Sound judgment on where AI helps and where it falls short; you double-check outputs for accuracy and handle confidential information responsibly

- You keep up with new AI tools and features and can explain them simply to teammates who are not technical

- Excellent written and spoken English, plus strong organization, initiative, and discretion

- Background in insurance, financial services, or any busy, operations-driven business is a bonus.



You'll Fit Right In If You

- Get excited about finding faster, smarter ways to work

- Like to understand a problem completely before you start building a fix

- Enjoy mixing technical projects with reliable, behind-the-scenes admin support

- Are looking for a stable, long-term role with a growing team, not short-term projects



How to Apply

STEP 1, REQUIRED: Record a 3 to 5 minute Loom video. Walk us through an AI workflow or automation that you built yourself. Explain the problem it solved, the tools you used, and what changed because of it. Paste your Loom link at the very top of your application. If there is no Loom video, your application will not be reviewed.



STEP 2: Below your Loom link, include:

A short overview of your virtual assistant background and the AI tools you use most

A brief answer to this question: "What is one task you automated with AI? What did it replace, and how much time does it save?"



A link to your most recent CV or resume

Confirmation that you can work full-time during Mountain Time business hours

title: Customer Success and RETENTION MANAGER
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Independent Contractor | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



This is an independent contractor role, not an employee position. You'll work under an independent contractor agreement.



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



PAY



- Starting base: USD 1,500/month

- Certified CSM base: USD 2,000/month

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is based on consistent quality work and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 8 PM-11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process. It must be sustainable long-term.



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an "80% done-for-you" content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp up gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent, professional English

- Clear spoken communication

- Emotional intelligence

- Be calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

title: Strategic Web Designer, Figma / Website Strategy
description:
Full-Time Remote Role, Philippines-Based

----------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a full-time Strategic Website Designer based in the Philippines.



This role is ideal for someone strong in Figma, who understands website design, and can think strategically about clients, their customers, brand direction, industry patterns, and what makes a website work.



This is not just a production design role. We are looking for someone who can understand the brief, think through the customer journey, research competitors, recommend website direction, and then support that direction in Figma.



Role Overview

-------------------

You will help turn client goals, customer needs, brand direction, website references, and competitor research into a clear internal website strategy and design direction.



You do not need to lead client calls, but you must be able to sit in meetings, understand what clients are saying, extract the important points, and translate that into useful internal notes, design direction, and Figma updates.



You will work closely with our internal team across website strategy, design, and delivery





Key Responsibilities

---------------------------

- Review client briefs, meeting notes, recordings, brand assets, and website references

- Understand what the client wants, what their customers need, and what the website needs to achieve

- Analyse websites the client likes and dislikes

- Research competitor websites and industry patterns

- Identify trust signals, conversion sections, content structure, and visual styles that work in each industry

- Recommend website direction based on customer needs and business goals

- Create look-and-feel concepts in Figma

- Create new website sections in Figma

- Improve layout, spacing, hierarchy, flow, and visual polish

- Update existing Figma designs based on internal direction

- Write clear internal notes explaining design decisions and strategic recommendations

- Keep ClickUp tasks updated with progress, blockers, and time entries

- Communicate clearly with the team via Slack and Google Docs

- Use ChatGPT to support research, summaries, and strategic thinking where useful



What We Are Looking For

-----------------------------------

You should be a mid-to-senior-level website designer with strong strategic thinking.



You should be able to take messy input and turn it into clear website direction.



We are looking for someone who can think before designing.



A strong candidate can say:

“Based on the customer’s needs, the homepage should build trust early, show proof, and make the offer clear, reduce friction, and use a more premium visual direction because the market is crowded.”



A weak candidate only says:

“I can make modern websites in Figma.”



We are looking for the first type.





Required Skills

---------------------

- Strong Figma skills

- Website design experience

- Ability to create new website sections, not just edit existing designs

- Good understanding of layout, spacing, hierarchy, and visual polish

- Ability to create early look-and-feel concepts

- Ability to understand client brands

- Ability to analyse competitor websites

- Ability to understand customer needs and website goals

- Clear written English for internal notes and design rationale

- Good communication in Slack and Google Docs

- Comfortable using ClickUp for task updates and time tracking

- Comfortable using ChatGPT as a thinking and research support tool



English Requirement

-----------------------------

You do not need to be a copywriter or client presenter.



However, you must be able to write clear internal notes, summarise client requirements, explain design decisions, and provide simple website section direction.



Example of the level we need:

“The client wants the site to feel modern, premium, and trustworthy. Their customers are likely comparing providers, so the homepage should quickly communicate credibility, outcomes, and service clarity. The reference websites suggest they prefer clean layouts, strong imagery, and simple navigation.”



Tools You Must Be Comfortable With

----------------------------------------------------

- Figma

- ClickUp

- Slack

- Google Docs

- ChatGPT



Work Hours

-----------------

This is a full-time role.



You must be available to work:

- 9:00 am to 5:30 pm Australian Eastern Standard Time



For candidates in the Philippines, this is usually around:

- 7:00 am to 3:30 pm Philippines time



Please only apply if you can work these hours long-term.



Role Structure

-------------------

- Full-time remote contractor role

- Philippines-based candidates only

- 3-month probation period

- If successful after probation, the role continues on the same agreed monthly salary

- 1 week's notice during probation

- 2 weeks' notice after probation

- Unpaid leave only

- Contractor must provide their own laptop, stable internet, and suitable work setup

- This is a fully exclusive role. You must not work with other clients while engaged in this role

- Daily time tracking is required in ClickUp

- No screenshots or activity monitoring required

- Confidentiality and IP ownership agreement required



Access and Confidentiality

------------------------------------

You will have access to internal documentation, project files, client information, Figma files, brand assets, and other materials required to do the role well.



All work created during the role, including strategy notes, design concepts, Figma files, website layouts, written documentation, research outputs, and related assets, will be owned by the company.



You may not share client work publicly, use it in a portfolio, or reuse it elsewhere without written approval.





Who This Role Is Not For

---------------------------------

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to follow the exact design instructions

- You are not comfortable thinking strategically

- You cannot explain your design decisions

- You do not like researching competitors or industries

- You only want production design tasks

- You cannot work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

- You are currently working with other clients and want to keep doing so

- You are not comfortable with ClickUp time tracking





How To Apply

--------------------

Submit your application to 



Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your Figma portfolio or links to website design work

3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

4. Confirmation that you can work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

5. Confirmation that you are available for a full-time exclusive role

6. A short answer to this question:



“Tell us about a website you designed or improved. What was the client trying to achieve, and who was the

customer, and why did you choose that design direction?”



Applications that only say “I am interested” without answering the above will not be considered



Alternatively, if you have a SkillCheck ID profile (
), feel free to send this across, as these will be prioritized.

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
Sculpd is on a mission to inspire a generation of 100 million crafters

In 2020, we set out to reinvent pottery. Once confined to the studios of trained ceramicists and the back rooms of trendy London cafes, pottery has long been a scarcely accessible and expensive part-time hobby. Or for most, it is something they haven’t tried since their school years. We set out to change that.

We built the brand around the idea that everyone is crafty in their own way. We’re inspiring people to create things with their hands that they are proud of while bringing people together in the process.



Since launch, we’ve built an audience of 1m+ on social media with over half a million happy customers globally. Expanding from pottery into adjacent crafts, it feels like we’ve only just started. We’re looking to build on our platform to make modern crafts part of everyone’s lives.



The role and how you’ll be working

The joy of working with clay starts when customers first hear about us and ends when they’ve told their friends about the amazing experience they just had. We continually strive to make their experiences with Sculpd amazing. The Customer team is responsible for ensuring each customer has an unforgettable experience with Sculpd, either by gifting to a friend or crafting themselves

Key responsibilities for this role are addressing customer queries over
 and social media, and consistently delivering outstanding levels of service

Assisting with day-to-day operational processes, e.g., order processing across different platforms and facilitating returns

Becoming the internal champion of Gorgias (our customer engagement platform) and continually refining its setup and usage across the team to better serve our customers

Proactively identifying customer issues to the rest of the team so they can be investigated and fixed



A bit about you

At least 1 year of experience in Customer Service

Are empathetic, love caring and helping people, and have excellent and proven customer service experience

title: Australian Mortgage Loan Processing Officer — Remote Philippines
description:
LoanTrekker Experience Essential | Minimum 2 Years Australian Mortgage Experience | Performance-Based Earnings



Company: Latitude Property Escapes (LPE) — Australia

Location: Philippines — 100% Remote

Employment Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Remuneration: Negotiable base payment plus performance fees in Philippine pesos (PHP)



About Us



Latitude Property Escapes (LPE) is an Australian property and finance services business seeking an experienced, reliable and highly organised Australian Mortgage Loan Processing Officer based in the Philippines.



We have an active pipeline of Australian residential mortgage clients and are looking for someone who can independently manage the loan administration process, from collecting client documentation through to preparing, lodging and progressing mortgage applications.



This is an opportunity for an experienced loan processor who enjoys working independently, delivering results and building a long-term professional relationship.



We are not looking for a general virtual assistant or someone requiring training in Australian mortgage processing.



Essential Requirements



Applicants MUST have:



Minimum 2 years' experience processing Australian residential mortgage applications.



Proven proficiency in LoanTrekker software — mandatory.



Experience collecting, reviewing and organising client financial documentation.



Demonstrated experience preparing and lodging Australian mortgage applications.



Experience using ApplyOnline and Australian lender submission portals.



Understanding of Australian mortgage compliance and lending requirements.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple active applications.



Reliable home internet connection, suitable computer equipment and a secure home office.



Availability to communicate with Australian clients, brokers and lenders during agreed Australian business hours.



Key Responsibilities



1. Client Documentation



Contact clients to obtain outstanding financial information.



Collect payslips, tax returns, identification and other supporting documents, and obtain bank statements through illion BankStatements where required, using the approved client-consent process.



Check documentation for accuracy, completeness and consistency.



Follow up outstanding information promptly.



2. LoanTrekker Data Entry



Create and maintain accurate client records.



Enter financial information, employment details, assets, liabilities and loan requirements.



Keep application records and document checklists updated.



3. Loan Preparation and Lodgement



Prepare complete mortgage application packages.



Assist with serviceability calculations and lender documentation.



Prepare applications for broker review and approval.



Lodge approved applications through ApplyOnline or relevant lender portals.



Ensure applications meet lender documentation and submission requirements.



4. Loan Progression



Follow up lenders regarding application status.



Coordinate outstanding conditions and additional documentation.



Monitor applications through conditional approval, formal approval and settlement.



Provide regular progress reports and maintain accurate pipeline records.



All credit recommendations, client advice and final compliance approvals remain the responsibility of the authorised Australian mortgage broker.



Remuneration — Strong Performance-Based Earning Potential



We are offering a negotiated base payment together with a performance fee for each successfully lodged and accepted mortgage application.



Our operational target is one completed loan lodgement per business day, with the longer-term objective of achieving an average of one loan settlement per business day as the pipeline matures.



At this level of activity, we anticipate the successful candidate could earn in excess of ₱50,000 per month, depending on the agreed payment structure and actual completed applications.



This represents an opportunity to build a strong, ongoing income with a growing Australian business.



A successful lodgement means:



All required client information has been collected and accurately entered.



The application package is complete and has passed the authorised broker's review.



The application has been submitted to the lender.



The lender has accepted the application into its processing system.



Payment terms, quality requirements and any applicable corrections will be agreed before work commences.



The daily lodgement and settlement figures are business targets, not guaranteed volumes or earnings.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL the following questions:



How many years have you worked processing Australian mortgage loans?



How many years of hands-on experience do you have using LoanTrekker?



Which Australian lenders and mortgage submission platforms have you worked with?



How many mortgage applications can you realistically prepare and lodge each week?



Have you managed applications from initial document collection through to settlement?



What fee in Philippine pesos (₱) would you expect for each successfully lodged and accepted Australian mortgage application, in addition to an agreed base payment?



Are you currently working for another Australian mortgage broker or outsourcing company?



When would you be available to commence?



Please attach your CV and provide a brief summary of your relevant Australian mortgage processing experience.



Important: Applicants without at least two years' Australian mortgage processing experience and demonstrated LoanTrekker proficiency will not be considered.



We are seeking a professional who can work independently, take ownership of assigned applications and become a valued long-term member of the Latitude Property Escapes team.



Latitude Property Escapes (LPE)

Australia

title: Experienced Amazon FBA Item sourcer
description:
# Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant



## Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Amazon FBA Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant to join our team. This position focuses on identifying profitable products through online arbitrage, retail arbitrage, and online wholesale sourcing.



The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Amazon FBA product research, sourcing strategies, and profitability analysis. Candidates should be experienced in identifying profitable opportunities, analyzing market data, and reverse sourcing existing Amazon sellers to determine where they purchase their inventory.



Grocery products are strongly preferred. Candidates with previous experience sourcing grocery products or examples of profitable grocery leads in their product spreadsheets will receive additional consideration.



Our goal is to build a consistent pipeline of profitable products with strong sales velocity, healthy margins, and opportunities for replenishment.



## Minimum Product Requirements



Products submitted for consideration must meet our target profitability criteria of at least $3 net profit per unit, a minimum ROI of 30%, and approximately 200 or more monthly sales.



We prioritize products with consistent demand, stable pricing, and manageable competition. Products with low sales volume or excessive variations should generally be avoided, especially when sales data is spread across multiple sizes, colors, or variations.



Grocery products are preferred due to their potential sourcing and tax advantages, which can help improve overall profit margins.



All profitability calculations must account for Amazon fees, shipping, sourcing costs, and other applicable expenses.



## Responsibilities



Research online retailers, e-commerce websites, and wholesalers to identify profitable Amazon FBA sourcing opportunities. Identify products with strong demand, competitive pricing, and consistent sales history.



Reverse source successful Amazon sellers to identify potential suppliers and original purchasing sources. Analyze Amazon listings, Buy Box prices, sales rank, competition, and historical pricing using tools such as Keepa and SellerAmp.



Calculate estimated net profit, ROI, Amazon fees, and shipping costs for every submitted product. Verify exact product matches, including UPCs, ASINs, variations, sizes, and quantities.



Identify potential risks, including restricted brands, price fluctuations, excessive competition, and low sales velocity. Maintain organized sourcing spreadsheets containing retailer links, Amazon listing links, purchase prices, estimated fees, net profit, ROI, and relevant product data.



Identify replenishable products that can provide consistent, long-term sourcing opportunities. Monitor pricing and market trends to identify new opportunities and maintain product profitability.



Please specify whether you already have access to Keepa, SellerAmp, or other product research tools, or whether you would require us to provide access.



## Requirements



Previous experience with Amazon FBA online arbitrage, retail arbitrage, or wholesale product sourcing is required. Candidates should be proficient with Keepa, SellerAmp, or comparable Amazon product research tools and have a strong understanding of Amazon FBA fees, ROI calculations, sales rank, Buy Box pricing, and product restrictions.



You must be able to identify profitable products using accurate sales and historical pricing data rather than relying solely on price differences. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience researching multiple retailers and wholesalers are essential.



Proficiency with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel is required, along with the ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver quality results.



## Important Details



This position focuses exclusively on finding profitable products to resell through Amazon FBA using online arbitrage, retail arbitrage, and online wholesale sourcing. We are not looking for traditional wholesale account outreach or brand authorization acquisition.



Every product recommendation must include accurate profitability calculations and verifiable sourcing links. Products must be evaluated based on actual demand, competition, historical pricing, and overall profitability.



We can provide a spreadsheet containing wholesale accounts that we already have established. You are welcome to use these accounts as additional sourcing resources when identifying profitable products.



## How to Apply



To be considered, please provide a brief overview of your Amazon FBA product sourcing experience, including the sourcing methods you specialize in, such as online arbitrage, retail arbitrage, wholesale arbitrage, or reverse sourcing.



Please explain which research tools you currently use and whether you would require us to provide access. Include your typical ROI, average net profit per unit, monthly sales volume for products you source, and experience identifying replenishable products.



**Required Sample Spreadsheet**



Please submit a spreadsheet containing 5–10 products you have previously sourced. Each product must include the product name and UPC, Amazon ASIN and listing link, retailer or supplier name and purchasing link, purchase price, current Amazon selling price, estimated Amazon FBA fees, estimated net profit per unit, ROI percentage, estimated monthly sales, and Keepa price and sales history.



We will use these examples to evaluate your sourcing experience, research accuracy, and ability to identify profitable opportunities.



**Application Instruction: Include the word RED at the end of your application to confirm that you have read the entire job listing.**



## Flexible Schedule & Growth Opportunities



We offer a flexible working schedule, allowing you to complete your hours during whichever times are most convenient for your local time zone. You are not required to follow a strict daily schedule, provided that agreed-upon hours are completed, deadlines are met, and communication remains consistent.



We are interested in building long-term working relationships with reliable, results-driven individuals.



Candidates who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, and the ability to identify profitable sourcing opportunities may have opportunities to transition into full-time positions as our business grows.



We also offer the potential for competitive pay increases and additional advancement opportunities based on work quality, sourcing results, reliability, and overall contribution to the business.



Our priority is finding someone who can consistently deliver legitimate, profitable sourcing opportunities and contribute to the long-term growth of our Amazon FBA business.

What We're Looking For

• Solid grasp of accounting fundamentals: reconciliations, accruals vs. cash basis, journal entries, A/P and A/R

Traits

title: Leasing Assistant – California Section 8 & Affordable Housing (US Hours)
description:
We're a US-based property management company looking for an experienced Leasing Assistant to help us fill our long-term rental properties in California, with a focus on Section 8 (Housing Choice Voucher) and low-income tenants. This is a full-time, long-term remote role.



Experience with California low-income housing and Section 8 is strongly preferred.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- US business hours, Pacific Time (night shift in the Philippines)



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- List vacant units on Section 8-friendly sites (GoSection8, 
, Zillow, and local housing authority lists)

- Respond quickly to inquiries from voucher holders and other prospects by phone, text, and

- Schedule showings and follow up with every prospect

- Screen applicants and verify income, landlord history, and voucher details

- Prepare and submit Request for Tenancy Approval (RFTA) packets and work with local housing authorities until approval

- Schedule and prepare units for housing authority (HQS/NSPIRE) inspections, and follow up on any items that fail

- Track the tenant portion vs. housing authority portion of rent, HAP contracts, and annual recertifications

- Prepare leases, coordinate move-ins, and keep records accurate in our property management software



PREFERRED

- Experience with California housing authorities (e.g., HACLA, LACDA, or other county agencies)

- Knowledge of payment standards, rent reasonableness, and the RFTA/HAP process

- Familiarity with LIHTC/affordable housing income certifications

- Understanding of California fair housing rules, including source-of-income protections



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years of US property management leasing experience

- Excellent written and spoken English, comfortable on the phone with tenants and housing authority caseworkers

- Experience with AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, or similar software

- Organized and persistent; housing authority approvals take follow-up

- Reliable internet, a backup power/internet plan, and a quiet place to work

- Able to work consistently during US Pacific business hours



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short message that includes:

1. Your leasing experience, including any Section 8 or affordable housing work (which states/housing authorities, and what you handled)

2. Software you've used (e.g. AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, GoSection8)

3. Confirmation that you can work US Pacific business hours



Please start your message with the word "VOUCHER" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it won't be reviewed.
